dialogue.py: Nín hǎo, wǒ jiào Yīwàn, láizì Éluósī, zài Zhōngguó gōngzuò sān nián le, zhīqián zuò kuàjìng diànshāng yùnyíng.
dialogue.ru: Hello, my name is Ivan, I'm from Russia, I've worked in China for three years, and previously I worked in operations in cross-border e-commerce.

dialogue.zh: 为什么想换工作？
dialogue.py: Wèishénme xiǎng huàn gōngzuò?
dialogue.ru: Why do you want to change jobs?

dialogue.zh: 我想找一个更大的平台，也希望能更多地负责俄罗斯市场。
dialogue.py: Wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yí ge gèng dà de píngtái, yě xīwàng néng gèng duō de fùzé Éluósī shìchǎng.
dialogue.ru: I want a bigger company, and I hope to take on more responsibility for the Russian market.

dialogue.zh: 你的中文不错。期望薪资是多少？
dialogue.py: Nǐ de Zhōngwén búcuò. Qīwàng xīnzī shì duōshao?
dialogue.ru: Your Chinese is good. What are your salary expectations?

dialogue.zh: 两万五左右，具体可以商量。请问公司能办工作签证吗？
dialogue.py: Liǎng wàn wǔ zuǒyòu, jùtǐ kěyǐ shāngliang. Qǐngwèn gōngsī néng bàn gōngzuò qiānzhèng ma?
dialogue.ru: About 25 thousand, and the details can be discussed. Does the company arrange work visas?

dialogue.zh: 可以，我们有外籍员工，HR会帮你办。你最快什么时候能入职？
dialogue.py: Kěyǐ, wǒmen yǒu wàijí yuángōng, HR huì bāng nǐ bàn. Nǐ zuì kuài shénme shíhou néng rùzhí?
dialogue.ru: Yes, we have foreign employees, HR will help. When could you start work?

dialogue.zh: 下个月一号就可以。
dialogue.py: Xià ge yuè yī hào jiù kěyǐ.
dialogue.ru: From the first of next month.

dialogue.zh: 好的，我们一周内给你答复。
dialogue.py: Hǎo de, wǒmen yì zhōu nèi gěi nǐ dáfù.
dialogue.ru: Okay, we'll reply within a week.

dialogue.zh: 谢谢您，期待您的消息。
dialogue.py: Xièxie nín, qīdài nín de xiāoxi.
dialogue.ru: Thank you, I'll be waiting for your reply.

topics.culture: One of the most popular job search sites is BOSS直聘: there you message the recruiter right away in a chat, and then communication usually moves to WeChat. In an interview, specifics (numbers, markets, results) and modesty are valued: don't criticize a previous employer and don't praise yourself too directly. Salary is discussed openly already at the first stage, in monthly terms and with the question “how many 薪 a year.” For a standard category B work permit (外国专业人才), as a general rule you need a bachelor's degree or higher and at least two years of experience in your field, and an age under 60. Ask HR who prepares the documents and at whose expense.

quiz.q: How do you politely say “your company” in an interview?
quiz.explain: 贵公司 is the polite form used in interviews and business correspondence.

quiz.q: What does “我的期望薪资是两万左右，可以商量” mean?
options: I'm being offered 20 thousand, but I refuse
I expect about 20 thousand and am open to discussion
I want exactly 20 thousand with no bargaining
quiz.explain: 期望薪资 means expected salary, 可以商量 means can be discussed.

quiz.q: What does “14薪” mean?
options: 14 monthly salaries a year, including the bonus
quiz.explain: The number before 薪 is how many months of salary are paid per year.

quiz.q: Which answer about yourself is best for a Chinese HR person?
options: 我之前在物流公司负责俄罗斯市场，三年销售额增长了一倍。
我以前的老板很差，所以我想走。
quiz.explain: Specifics and numbers are valued, but bragging and criticizing a former boss are not.

role.ai_role: an HR manager at an electronics export company in Shenzhen, polite but asks follow-up questions
role.user_goal: go through a first interview for a sales manager position for the Russian market: introduce yourself, talk about your experience, name your expected salary, and ask about the visa
role.opening: 你好，欢迎来面试！请先用中文简单介绍一下你自己吧。
checklist: Introduced yourself and described your work experience with numbers
Explained why you want to work at this company (贵公司)
Named your expected salary and showed your willingness to discuss it
Asked about the work visa or the probation period
Politely thanked them for the interview

topics.title: First Day and Colleagues
topics.intro: The first day in a Chinese office: you need to introduce yourself to the team, find your desk, get a laptop and access, and be added to work chats. Learn phrases for meeting people, everyday office questions, and how to address colleagues properly.

phrases.zh: 大家好，我是新来的同事安娜，以后请多多关照！
phrases.py: Dàjiā hǎo, wǒ shì xīn lái de tóngshì Ānnà, yǐhòu qǐng duōduō guānzhào!
phrases.ru: Hi everyone, I'm Anna, the new colleague, I look forward to your support!
phrases.note: 请多多关照 is the must-say formula when meeting the team.
A safe way to find out whether to call a person by first name, “王总,” “李姐,” etc.

phrases.zh: 我在市场部，负责海外推广。
phrases.py: Wǒ zài shìchǎngbù, fùzé hǎiwài tuīguǎng.
phrases.ru: I'm in the marketing department, responsible for overseas promotion.

phrases.py: Qǐngwèn wǒ de gōngwèi zài nǎr?
phrases.ru: Could you tell me where my desk is?
Who do I go to for a computer?

phrases.py: Gōngsī de Wi-Fi mìmǎ shì duōshao?

phrases.zh: 我们用钉钉还是企业微信打卡？
phrases.py: Wǒmen yòng Dīngdīng háishi Qǐyè Wēixìn dǎkǎ?
phrases.ru: Do we clock in with DingTalk or WeCom?
phrases.note: 打卡 means clocking in/out; almost everywhere it's done through the phone.

phrases.zh: 可以把我拉进部门群吗？
phrases.py: Kěyǐ bǎ wǒ lājìn bùmén qún ma?
phrases.ru: Could you add me to the department chat?
phrases.note: 拉进群 literally means “pull into” a group chat.

phrases.zh: 咱们加个微信吧，我扫你。
phrases.py: Zánmen jiā ge Wēixìn ba, wǒ sǎo nǐ.
phrases.ru: Let's add each other on WeChat, I'll scan you.

phrases.zh: 有不懂的地方还要向您请教。
phrases.py: Yǒu bù dǒng de dìfang hái yào xiàng nín qǐngjiào.
phrases.ru: If there's anything I don't understand, I'll come to you for advice.
phrases.note: 请教 is a modest “ask for advice” from someone more experienced.

phrases.zh: 中午大家一般在哪儿吃饭？
phrases.py: Zhōngwǔ dàjiā yìbān zài nǎr chīfàn?
phrases.ru: Where does everyone usually have lunch?
Where is the kitchen (the room with tea and water)?
Today is my first day, I'm a little nervous.

dialogue.zh: 大家停一下，这是新来的同事，安德烈。
dialogue.py: Dàjiā tíng yíxià, zhè shì xīn lái de tóngshì, Āndéliè.
dialogue.ru: Everyone, attention for a minute: this is our new colleague, Andrei.

dialogue.zh: 大家好！我叫安德烈，叫我安德就行。以后请多多关照！
dialogue.py: Dàjiā hǎo! Wǒ jiào Āndéliè, jiào wǒ Āndé jiù xíng. Yǐhòu qǐng duōduō guānzhào!
dialogue.ru: Hi everyone! My name is Andrei, you can just call me Ande. I look forward to your support!

dialogue.zh: 我是小王，你的工位就在我旁边。电脑IT下午给你送过来。
dialogue.py: Wǒ shì Xiǎo Wáng, nǐ de gōngwèi jiù zài wǒ pángbiān. Diànnǎo IT xiàwǔ gěi nǐ sòng guòlai.
dialogue.ru: I'm Xiao Wang, your desk is next to mine. IT will bring your computer after lunch.

dialogue.zh: 太好了，谢谢！我们怎么打卡？
dialogue.py: Tài hǎo le, xièxie! Wǒmen zěnme dǎkǎ?
dialogue.ru: Great, thanks! And how do we clock in?

dialogue.zh: 用企业微信，九点半之前打卡就行。我先把你拉进部门群。
dialogue.py: Yòng Qǐyè Wēixìn, jiǔ diǎn bàn zhīqián dǎkǎ jiù xíng. Wǒ xiān bǎ nǐ lājìn bùmén qún.
dialogue.ru: Through WeCom, you need to clock in by 9:30. I'll add you to the department chat now.

dialogue.zh: 好的。请问咱们部门领导怎么称呼？
dialogue.py: Hǎo de. Qǐngwèn zánmen bùmén lǐngdǎo zěnme chēnghu?
dialogue.ru: Okay. And how should I address the head of our department?

dialogue.zh: 叫刘总就行。中午要不要跟我们一起去吃饭？
dialogue.py: Jiào Liú zǒng jiù xíng. Zhōngwǔ yào bu yào gēn wǒmen yìqǐ qù chīfàn?
dialogue.ru: Just “Liu zong.” Will you come to lunch with us?

dialogue.zh: 好啊！有不懂的地方还要多向你请教。
dialogue.py: Hǎo a! Yǒu bù dǒng de dìfang hái yào duō xiàng nǐ qǐngjiào.
dialogue.ru: Gladly! If there's anything I don't understand, I'll ask you.

topics.culture: A boss is usually addressed by surname + title: 王总 (general manager/director), 李经理, 张老师 (in education and creative fields). Peers are called by first name or 小王, and slightly older colleagues 王姐 / 李哥; this is warm and normal. Almost all work life runs through 企业微信, 钉钉, or 飞书 (Feishu/Lark): clocking in, requests, documents. Install the app you need on the very first day. Lunch with the team on the first day is a good sign, so don't decline; in return, in a couple of weeks you can treat everyone to coffee or milk tea (奶茶).

quiz.q: Which phrase must you say when introducing yourself to the team?
quiz.explain: 请多多关照 is the standard formula for meeting people: “I ask for your support and goodwill.”

quiz.q: How do you usually address a director whose surname is Liu?
quiz.explain: Surname + 总 is the standard way to address a manager.

quiz.q: What does “把我拉进群” mean?
options: Add me to the group chat
quiz.explain: 拉进群 means to add to a group chat in WeChat/WeCom.

quiz.q: What is 打卡 in an office?
options: Paying by card in the canteen
quiz.explain: 打卡 means to clock in/out, usually in 钉钉 or 企业微信.

role.ai_role: a friendly colleague, Xiao Wang from the marketing department at a Beijing office, who helps the newcomer settle in
role.user_goal: on your first day at work, introduce yourself, find out where your desk is and how to clock in, get added on WeChat and in the department chat, and arrange to have lunch together
role.opening: 嗨，你就是今天新来的同事吧？我是小王，欢迎欢迎！
checklist: Introduced yourself and said 请多多关照
Asked about your desk, computer, or Wi-Fi
Found out how to clock in (打卡)
Asked to be added on WeChat or in the department chat
Arranged to have lunch together

topics.title: Meetings: Opinion, Agreement, Objection
topics.intro: In meetings at a Chinese company it's important not to stay silent, but also not to “chop down” colleagues with a blunt “no.” You'll learn to state an opinion, agree, object gently, interrupt politely, and sum up the meeting.

phrases.ru: I'd like to add one point.
phrases.note: The gentlest way to join the discussion.

phrases.py: Wǒ tóngyì Liú zǒng de kànfǎ.
phrases.ru: I agree with Mr. Liu's view.

phrases.py: Nǐ shuō de yǒu dàolǐ, búguò……
phrases.note: First acknowledge that the other person is right, then object.

phrases.py: Wǒ yǒu yìdiǎn bùtóng de xiǎngfǎ.
phrases.ru: I have a slightly different thought.
phrases.note: “一点” softens the disagreement.

phrases.zh: 从客户的角度来看，这个价格有点高。
phrases.py: Cóng kèhù de jiǎodù lái kàn, zhège jiàgé yǒudiǎn gāo.
phrases.ru: From the client's point of view, this price is a bit high.

phrases.zh: 这个方案可能还有一个问题。
phrases.py: Zhège fāng'àn kěnéng hái yǒu yí ge wèntí.
phrases.ru: This option may have one more problem.

phrases.zh: 能不能再考虑一下时间安排？
phrases.py: Néng bu néng zài kǎolǜ yíxià shíjiān ānpái?
phrases.ru: Could we think again about the timing?
Sorry, let me interrupt for a second.

phrases.zh: 我没太听清楚，能再说一遍吗？
phrases.py: Wǒ méi tài tīng qīngchu, néng zài shuō yí biàn ma?
phrases.ru: I didn't quite catch that, could you say it again?
Let's first align on the goals.
phrases.note: 对齐 (“to align”) is a trendy corporate buzzword, especially in IT.

phrases.zh: 这个问题我们会后再沟通。
phrases.py: Zhège wèntí wǒmen huìhòu zài gōutōng.
phrases.ru: We'll discuss this question after the meeting.
phrases.note: A convenient way to take a contentious issue out of the general discussion.

phrases.py: Zhè jiàn shì shéi lái gēnjìn?
phrases.ru: Who will follow up on this?

phrases.zh: 我确认一下，今天的结论是……
phrases.py: Wǒ quèrèn yíxià, jīntiān de jiélùn shì……
phrases.ru: Let me confirm: today's conclusion is…

phrases.py: Huìyì jìyào wǒ lái fā ba.
phrases.ru: I'll send out the minutes of the meeting.
I have no questions on my side.

dialogue.zh: 这次的推广方案大家怎么看？
dialogue.py: Zhè cì de tuīguǎng fāng'àn dàjiā zěnme kàn?
dialogue.ru: What does everyone think about the promotion plan?

dialogue.zh: 我觉得整体不错。我补充一点：俄罗斯客户更习惯用Telegram。
dialogue.py: Wǒ juéde zhěngtǐ búcuò. Wǒ bǔchōng yì diǎn: Éluósī kèhù gèng xíguàn yòng Telegram.
dialogue.ru: Generally not bad. I'll add: Russian clients are more used to Telegram.

dialogue.zh: 有道理。那预算呢？
dialogue.py: Yǒu dàolǐ. Nà yùsuàn ne?
dialogue.ru: Makes sense. And the budget?

dialogue.zh: 预算我有一点不同的想法。从客户的角度来看，第一个月投这么多，可能风险有点大。
dialogue.py: Yùsuàn wǒ yǒu yìdiǎn bùtóng de xiǎngfǎ. Cóng kèhù de jiǎodù lái kàn, dì-yī ge yuè tóu zhème duō, kěnéng fēngxiǎn yǒudiǎn dà.
dialogue.ru: On the budget I have a slightly different opinion. From the clients' side, investing that much in the first month may be risky.

dialogue.zh: 你的意思是先小范围测试？
dialogue.py: Nǐ de yìsi shì xiān xiǎo fànwéi cèshì?
dialogue.ru: So test on a small scale first?

dialogue.zh: 对，能不能先测试两周，再看数据？
dialogue.py: Duì, néng bu néng xiān cèshì liǎng zhōu, zài kàn shùjù?
dialogue.ru: Yes, maybe two weeks of tests first, and then we'll look at the data?

dialogue.zh: 可以。那这件事谁来跟进？
dialogue.py: Kěyǐ. Nà zhè jiàn shì shéi lái gēnjìn?
dialogue.ru: Okay. Who will follow up on this?

dialogue.zh: 我来跟进吧。我确认一下：先测试两周，下周五前出数据。会议纪要我来发。
dialogue.py: Wǒ lái gēnjìn ba. Wǒ quèrèn yíxià: xiān cèshì liǎng zhōu, xià zhōuwǔ qián chū shùjù. Huìyì jìyào wǒ lái fā.
dialogue.ru: I'll take it. To sum up: two weeks of tests first, data by next Friday. I'll send out the minutes.

topics.culture: In Chinese meetings the last word usually belongs to the most senior person, and arguing with them publicly is a serious blow to their 面子. Object using “softeners”: 有道理，不过…, 我有一点不同的想法, 可能, 能不能再考虑一下. If the disagreement is serious, it's better to talk to your manager one-on-one before or after the meeting (会后再沟通). The silence of Chinese colleagues doesn't always mean agreement; often they're simply waiting for what the boss says. After a meeting it's customary to send the 会议纪要 to the work chat: this is appreciated and is your chance to show initiative.

quiz.q: What is the gentlest way to begin an objection?
quiz.explain: First we acknowledge that the other person is right, then gently introduce our own opinion.

quiz.q: What does “对齐一下目标” mean?
quiz.explain: 对齐 is corporate jargon: to agree and arrive at a shared understanding.

quiz.q: You seriously disagree with the director's decision. What is the best thing to do?
options: Discuss it with them in person after the meeting
Object loudly in front of everyone
Stay silent and not do the task
quiz.explain: A public argument with your boss hurts their 面子; it's better to 会后再沟通.

quiz.q: How do you politely interrupt in a meeting?
quiz.explain: 不好意思，打断一下 is the standard polite formula.

role.ai_role: Zhang, head of the sales department, leads a meeting in the Shanghai office; he's confident in his plan but open to arguments
role.user_goal: in a meeting, gently object to a budget that is too large for the first month, propose a two-week test, and take the task on yourself
role.opening: 好，我们开始吧。下个月俄罗斯市场的推广，我打算一次性投五十万。大家有什么意见？
checklist: First acknowledged the strengths of the plan (有道理 / 我同意…)
Gently expressed disagreement (不过 / 我有一点不同的想法)
Proposed an alternative with an argument
Took the task on yourself or clarified who will follow up (跟进)
Summed up or offered to send out the 会议纪要

topics.title: Tasks, Deadlines, and Reporting to Your Boss
topics.intro: Everyday work: receiving a task, clarifying the deadline and priority, reporting on progress, honestly warning about a delay. You'll learn to report to your boss briefly and clearly, the way it's done in a Chinese office.

phrases.ru: Got it, I'll get on it right away.
phrases.note: 收到 is the most common word in work chats: “received, understood.”

phrases.ru: I can finish it by Friday.

phrases.py: Zhè liǎng ge rènwu nǎge yōuxiān?
phrases.ru: Which of the two tasks is the priority?

phrases.zh: 目前进度大概百分之八十。
phrases.py: Mùqián jìndù dàgài bǎi fēn zhī bāshí.

phrases.zh: 跟您汇报一下这周的进展。
phrases.py: Gēn nín huìbào yíxià zhè zhōu de jìnzhǎn.
phrases.ru: Let me report to you on this week's progress.
phrases.note: 汇报 means to report upward, only to your boss.

phrases.zh: 遇到一个问题，需要您确认一下。
phrases.py: Yùdào yí ge wèntí, xūyào nín quèrèn yíxià.
phrases.ru: I've run into a problem and need your confirmation.

phrases.note: 拍板 means to make the final decision (colloquial).

phrases.zh: 不好意思，恐怕要延期两天。
phrases.py: Bù hǎoyìsi, kǒngpà yào yánqī liǎng tiān.
phrases.ru: Sorry, I'm afraid it will have to be pushed back by two days.
phrases.note: Warn about a delay in advance and name the new deadline right away.

phrases.zh: 供应商还没回复，我已经在催了。
phrases.py: Gōngyìngshāng hái méi huífù, wǒ yǐjīng zài cuī le.
phrases.ru: The supplier hasn't replied yet, and I'm already chasing them.

phrases.py: Wǒ jīntiān xiàbān qián fā gěi nín.
phrases.ru: I'll send it to you before the end of the workday.

phrases.note: Colloquial, with colleagues and a not-too-formal boss.

phrases.zh: 这个我还不太熟悉，能给我讲一下吗？
phrases.py: Zhège wǒ hái bú tài shúxi, néng gěi wǒ jiǎng yíxià ma?
phrases.ru: I'm not very familiar with this yet, could you explain it to me?
If anything comes up, come to me anytime.

dialogue.zh: 安娜，给俄罗斯客户的报价单什么时候能好？
dialogue.py: Ānnà, gěi Éluósī kèhù de bàojiàdān shénme shíhou néng hǎo?
dialogue.ru: Anna, when will the commercial proposal for the Russian client be ready?

dialogue.zh: 王总，目前进度大概百分之七十。不过遇到一个问题，需要您确认一下。
dialogue.py: Wáng zǒng, mùqián jìndù dàgài bǎi fēn zhī qīshí. Búguò yùdào yí ge wèntí, xūyào nín quèrèn yíxià.
dialogue.ru: Wang zong, it's about 70% done right now. But I have a question and need your confirmation.

dialogue.zh: 什么问题？
dialogue.py: Shénme wèntí?
dialogue.ru: What's the question?

dialogue.zh: 客户要求用人民币结算，还要九十天账期。这个得您来拍板。
dialogue.py: Kèhù yāoqiú yòng rénmínbì jiésuàn, hái yào jiǔshí tiān zhàngqī. Zhège děi nín lái pāibǎn.
dialogue.ru: The client wants to settle in yuan with a 90-day payment deferral. This one is for you to decide.

dialogue.zh: 人民币可以，账期最多六十天。
dialogue.py: Rénmínbì kěyǐ, zhàngqī zuì duō liùshí tiān.
dialogue.ru: Yuan is fine, the deferral is 60 days at most.

dialogue.zh: 收到。那我改一下，恐怕要晚一天，明天上午发给您可以吗？
dialogue.py: Shōudào. Nà wǒ gǎi yíxià, kǒngpà yào wǎn yì tiān, míngtiān shàngwǔ fā gěi nín kěyǐ ma?
dialogue.ru: Got it. Then I'll revise it; I'm afraid it will take another day. May I send it tomorrow morning?

dialogue.zh: 可以，但是最晚十点。
dialogue.py: Kěyǐ, dànshì zuì wǎn shí diǎn.
dialogue.ru: You may, but no later than ten.

dialogue.zh: 好的，十点前一定发给您。
dialogue.py: Hǎo de, shí diǎn qián yídìng fā gěi nín.
dialogue.ru: Okay, I'll definitely send it by ten.

topics.culture: In Chinese companies the boss expects you to report on your own, without waiting to be asked: a short WeChat message “王总，跟您汇报一下进展…” is valued more than a perfect report a week later. Bad news is reported early and right away with a solution or a new deadline; the phrase 恐怕要延期 without a plan looks irresponsible. The word “收到” in reply to a task is a must: silence is taken to mean that you didn't read it. Keep in mind that deadlines often “float” and tasks arrive in the evening, so clarify priority with the question 哪个优先?

quiz.q: Your boss sent a task in WeChat. What do you reply first?
quiz.explain: 收到 confirms that you've seen the task and are taking it on.

quiz.q: What does “这个得您来拍板” mean?
quiz.explain: 拍板 means to make the final decision.

quiz.q: How do you properly warn about a delay?
options: 不好意思，恐怕要延期两天，周三上午发给您。
quiz.explain: An apology + the soft 恐怕 + a new specific deadline.

quiz.q: Who do you say “汇报” to?
quiz.explain: 汇报 means to report upward, to a manager.

role.ai_role: Director Wang, a demanding manager at a company in Yiwu, writes briefly and likes specific deadlines
role.user_goal: report on the progress of an order for a client from Kazakhstan, get a decision on the discount, and agree on a one-day deadline extension
role.opening: 那个哈萨克斯坦客户的订单，现在什么情况了？
checklist: Reported progress yourself with a specific figure (进度…)
Described the problem and asked for a decision (确认 / 拍板)
Warned about the delay gently (恐怕) and named a new deadline
Confirmed the instruction you received (收到)

topics.title: Messaging in WeChat and Email
topics.intro: Most work communication in China goes through WeChat, WeCom, and Feishu, while email remains for clients, foreign partners, and official documents. You'll learn politeness formulas for chats and emails, and how to ask, remind, and apologize for a late reply.

phrases.ru: Okay, thanks for your hard work!
phrases.note: 辛苦了 is thanks for someone's effort; to a boss it's better to say “辛苦您了.”

phrases.zh: 打扰一下，想问您一个问题。
phrases.py: Dǎrǎo yíxià, xiǎng wèn nín yí ge wèntí.
phrases.ru: Sorry to bother you, I wanted to ask something.

phrases.zh: 麻烦您看一下这个文件。
phrases.py: Máfan nín kàn yíxià zhège wénjiàn.
phrases.ru: Please take a look at this file.
phrases.note: 麻烦您… is a universal polite request.

phrases.zh: 方便的时候回复我一下。
phrases.py: Fāngbiàn de shíhou huífù wǒ yíxià.
phrases.ru: Please reply to me when it's convenient.
Sorry, I just saw the message.

phrases.py: Wǒ wǎndiǎn zài gēn nín quèrèn.
phrases.ru: I'll confirm with you a bit later.

phrases.zh: 温馨提醒：明天下午三点开会。
phrases.py: Wēnxīn tíxǐng: míngtiān xiàwǔ sān diǎn kāihuì.
phrases.ru: Friendly reminder: there's a meeting tomorrow at 3 p.m.
phrases.note: 温馨提醒 is a soft “just a reminder,” often used in group chats.
Only with close colleagues; to a boss it's better to state the point of your question right away.

phrases.zh: 我不太方便听语音，可以打字吗？
phrases.py: Wǒ bú tài fāngbiàn tīng yǔyīn, kěyǐ dǎzì ma?
phrases.ru: It's inconvenient for me to listen to voice messages, can you type instead?

phrases.zh: 附件是本月的报价单，请查收。
phrases.py: Fùjiàn shì běn yuè de bàojiàdān, qǐng cháshōu.
phrases.ru: Attached is this month's price list, please check that you've received it.
phrases.note: 请查收 is the standard ending of an email with an attachment.

phrases.py: Zūnjìng de Lǐ zǒng: Nín hǎo!
phrases.note: The formal opening of an email.

phrases.zh: 如有任何问题，请随时与我联系。
phrases.py: Rú yǒu rènhé wèntí, qǐng suíshí yǔ wǒ liánxì.
phrases.ru: If you have any questions, feel free to contact me at any time.
All the best! (at the end of an email)
phrases.note: A modern neutral sign-off; “此致敬礼” is very formal.

dialogue.zh: 李经理，打扰一下。合同已经发到您邮箱了，麻烦您看一下。
dialogue.py: Lǐ jīnglǐ, dǎrǎo yíxià. Hétong yǐjīng fā dào nín yóuxiāng le, máfan nín kàn yíxià.
dialogue.ru: Manager Li, sorry to bother you. The contract is already in your inbox, please take a look.

dialogue.zh: 收到。我下午开会，晚点回复你。
dialogue.py: Shōudào. Wǒ xiàwǔ kāihuì, wǎndiǎn huífù nǐ.
dialogue.ru: Got it. I have a meeting after lunch, I'll reply later.

dialogue.zh: 好的，辛苦了！客户希望明天之前确认。
dialogue.py: Hǎo de, xīnkǔ le! Kèhù xīwàng míngtiān zhīqián quèrèn.
dialogue.ru: Okay, thanks! The client would like confirmation by tomorrow.

dialogue.zh: 不好意思，回复晚了。第三条的付款方式要改一下。
dialogue.py: Bù hǎoyìsi, huífù wǎn le. Dì-sān tiáo de fùkuǎn fāngshì yào gǎi yíxià.
dialogue.ru: Sorry for replying late. In clause 3 the payment method needs to be changed.

dialogue.zh: 明白。我改好后再发您确认。
dialogue.py: Míngbai. Wǒ gǎi hǎo hòu zài fā nín quèrèn.
dialogue.ru: Understood. I'll fix it and send it to you for confirmation.

dialogue.zh: 好的。另外，你给客户发邮件的时候抄送我一下。
dialogue.py: Hǎo de. Lìngwài, nǐ gěi kèhù fā yóujiàn de shíhou chāosòng wǒ yíxià.
dialogue.ru: Okay. And when you write to the client, put me in copy.

dialogue.zh: 没问题，发完跟您说。
dialogue.py: Méi wèntí, fā wán gēn nín shuō.
dialogue.ru: No problem, I'll send it and let you know.

dialogue.zh: 👍 辛苦了！
dialogue.py: Xīnkǔ le!
dialogue.ru: 👍 Thanks for your hard work!

topics.culture: In work chats you need to reply quickly, at least with “收到,” otherwise silence is taken as inattention. Chinese people send voice messages (语音) all the time, but asking them to write in text is normal. Be careful with emoji: 🙂 is seen by many Chinese people as a cold or ironic smile, while 👍 and 🙏 are safe (for the older generation 👍 can sound a bit condescending, but in work chats it's the norm). Emails are written more formally: the salutation 尊敬的…, attachments with “请查收,” a copy to your boss (抄送). In a group chat, “@所有人” is usually used only by the manager or administrator.

quiz.q: Which emoji in a work chat can sound cold or ironic?
quiz.explain: The smile 🙂 in China is often read as passive aggression.

quiz.q: How do you end an email with an attachment?
quiz.explain: 请查收 means “please check that you've received it,” the standard for attachments.

quiz.q: Why shouldn't you write to your boss just “在吗？”?
options: That word is banned in WeCom
It's better to state the point right away rather than make them wait
quiz.explain: “在吗” without the point of the question is annoying; with your boss, write about the matter straight away.

quiz.q: What does “抄送我一下” mean?
quiz.explain: 抄送 means a copy (CC) in an email.

role.ai_role: Manager Li from the purchasing department, replies in WeChat briefly, sometimes with a delay, and sends voice messages
role.user_goal: in a chat, ask them to review the contract by tomorrow, politely remind them of the deadline, ask them to write in text instead of voice messages, and say thank you
role.opening: [语音 0:45] 喂，合同我还没看，你那边急不急啊？
checklist: Used a polite request (麻烦您 / 打扰一下)
Named a specific deadline
Politely asked them to write in text (可以打字吗)
Said thank you (辛苦了 / 谢谢)

topics.title: Asking for Time Off: Sick Leave, Vacation
topics.intro: You're sick, need to leave early, or want to take time off for the holidays: a Chinese company has its own words and procedure for this. Learn to ask for different kinds of 请假, arrange the handover of your work, and understand the system of shifted workdays (调休).

phrases.py: Liú zǒng, wǒ xiǎng qǐng ge jià.
phrases.ru: Liu zong, I'd like to ask for some time off.
phrases.note: 请假 is any absence: a day off, sick leave, vacation.

phrases.zh: 我身体不舒服，今天想请病假。
phrases.py: Wǒ shēntǐ bù shūfu, jīntiān xiǎng qǐng bìngjià.
phrases.ru: I'm not feeling well, I'd like to take sick leave today.

phrases.zh: 我发烧了，上午去医院看一下。
phrases.py: Wǒ fāshāo le, shàngwǔ qù yīyuàn kàn yíxià.
phrases.ru: I have a fever, I'll go to the hospital in the morning.
Do I need a sick note?
phrases.note: A certificate (病假条 / 诊断证明) is issued by the hospital after an appointment.

phrases.zh: 我想请年假，下周一到周三。
phrases.py: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng niánjià, xià zhōuyī dào zhōusān.
phrases.ru: I'd like to take annual leave from Monday to Wednesday next week.

phrases.zh: 家里有点急事，下午能早点走吗？
phrases.py: Jiāli yǒudiǎn jíshì, xiàwǔ néng zǎodiǎn zǒu ma?
phrases.ru: Something urgent has come up at home, may I leave early this afternoon?

phrases.py: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng yì tiān shìjià.
phrases.ru: I'd like to take one day of unpaid leave.
phrases.note: 事假 is leave for personal matters, usually unpaid.

phrases.ru: I'd like to take a day off in lieu.
phrases.note: 调休 is a day off in exchange for a worked day off or overtime. It's also the name for the government's shifting of days off around holidays.

phrases.zh: 我明天在家办公可以吗？
phrases.py: Wǒ míngtiān zài jiā bàngōng kěyǐ ma?
phrases.ru: May I work from home tomorrow?

phrases.zh: 我的工作已经交接给小李了。
phrases.py: Wǒ de gōngzuò yǐjīng jiāojiē gěi Xiǎo Lǐ le.
phrases.ru: I've already handed over my work to Xiao Li.

phrases.zh: 我已经在OA上提交了申请，麻烦您批一下。
phrases.py: Wǒ yǐjīng zài OA shang tíjiāo le shēnqǐng, máfan nín pī yíxià.
phrases.ru: I've already submitted the request in the system, please approve it.
phrases.note: OA is an internal system (often in 钉钉/企业微信/飞书).

phrases.zh: 有急事可以随时联系我，我手机一直开着。
phrases.py: Yǒu jíshì kěyǐ suíshí liánxì wǒ, wǒ shǒujī yìzhí kāizhe.
phrases.ru: If anything is urgent, call me anytime, my phone is always on.
How many days off are there for National Day?
Is this Saturday a working day (a make-up day)?
phrases.note: 补班 is a working Saturday/Sunday to make up for long holidays.

phrases.zh: 我回国探亲，想连着年假一起休。
phrases.py: Wǒ huí guó tànqīn, xiǎng liánzhe niánjià yìqǐ xiū.
phrases.ru: I'm going home to visit relatives and would like to add annual leave to it.

dialogue.zh: 刘总，早上好。不好意思，我昨晚开始发烧，今天想请一天病假。
dialogue.py: Liú zǒng, zǎoshang hǎo. Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ zuó wǎn kāishǐ fāshāo, jīntiān xiǎng qǐng yì tiān bìngjià.
dialogue.ru: Liu zong, good morning. Sorry, I've had a fever since last night and would like to take sick leave today.

dialogue.zh: 好，好好休息。今天下午的客户会怎么办？
dialogue.py: Hǎo, hǎohǎo xiūxi. Jīntiān xiàwǔ de kèhù huì zěnme bàn?
dialogue.ru: Okay, get some rest. And what about today's meeting with the client?

dialogue.zh: 资料我已经发给小李了，她可以先去。有急事可以随时联系我。
dialogue.py: Zīliào wǒ yǐjīng fā gěi Xiǎo Lǐ le, tā kěyǐ xiān qù. Yǒu jíshì kěyǐ suíshí liánxì wǒ.
dialogue.ru: I've already sent the materials to Xiao Li, she can go. If anything is urgent, message me anytime.

dialogue.zh: 行。记得在钉钉上提交请假申请。
dialogue.py: Xíng. Jìde zài Dīngdīng shang tíjiāo qǐngjià shēnqǐng.
dialogue.ru: Okay. Don't forget to submit the request in DingTalk.

dialogue.zh: 好的。需要开病假条吗？
dialogue.py: Hǎo de. Xūyào kāi bìngjiàtiáo ma?
dialogue.ru: Okay. Do I need a doctor's note?

dialogue.zh: 一天不用，超过两天要开。
dialogue.py: Yì tiān bú yòng, chāoguò liǎng tiān yào kāi.
dialogue.ru: For one day you don't, if it's more than two you do.

dialogue.zh: 明白了。另外，我想春节前后连着年假一起休，可以吗？
dialogue.py: Míngbai le. Lìngwài, wǒ xiǎng Chūnjié qiánhòu liánzhe niánjià yìqǐ xiū, kěyǐ ma?
dialogue.ru: Understood. And one more thing: I'd like to add annual leave to Spring Festival, is that possible?

dialogue.zh: 可以，先把工作安排好，下周跟我确认日期。
dialogue.py: Kěyǐ, xiān bǎ gōngzuò ānpái hǎo, xià zhōu gēn wǒ quèrèn rìqī.
dialogue.ru: It is. First divide up your work, and next week we'll agree on the dates.

topics.culture: By law, paid annual leave in China is short: the right to it arises after a year of continuous work, and the length depends on total work experience: 5 days for 1 to 10 years, 10 days for 10 to 20 years, 15 days for 20 years or more; many companies give more, so check the exact terms in your employment contract. Long holidays (Spring Festival, National Day) are often “assembled” by shifting days: before or after them there are working Saturdays and Sundays (补班). The State Council publishes next year's schedule on gov.cn, usually in November. For example, in 2026 National Day runs from October 1 to 7, and September 20 (Sun) and October 10 (Sat) are working days. If you are nonetheless called in to work on an ordinary day off, the law entitles you to a day off in lieu (补休) or pay of at least 200%, and on an official holiday at least 300%. A request is submitted in the OA system (钉钉, 企业微信, 飞书), but it's better to warn your boss first in person or in the chat. It's good form to say who you handed your work over to (交接) and to stay reachable.

quiz.q: What is 补班?
options: A working day off in exchange for long holidays
quiz.explain: 补班 is working on a day off before/after long holidays.

quiz.q: Which kind of leave is usually unpaid?
options: 病假 with a doctor's note
quiz.explain: 事假 is leave for personal matters, as a rule unpaid.

quiz.q: How many days of paid leave does the law guarantee for 3 years of total work experience?
quiz.explain: For 1 to 10 years of experience, 5 days.

quiz.q: What is important to tell your boss when asking for time off?
options: 工作已经交接给小李了，有急事可以联系我。
quiz.explain: Show that your work has been handed over (交接) and that you are reachable.

role.ai_role: Department head Liu, a decent person but worried about the project, who asks questions about the handover of work
role.user_goal: ask for sick leave today, explain who will stand in at the meeting, and arrange three days of annual leave before Spring Festival
role.opening: 喂，早啊。怎么了，听起来声音不太对？
checklist: Explained the reason and asked for 病假
Said who you handed your work over to (交接)
Promised to stay reachable
Asked for 年假 with specific dates
Asked about the request in the system or the sick note

topics.title: Company Dinner and Toasts
topics.intro: Business dinners, department dinners (聚餐), and the New Year company party (年会) are an important part of work in China. You'll learn to give short toasts, thank your management, politely drink less or not at all, and behave at a round table.

phrases.ru: Allow me to drink to you!
phrases.note: 敬 means to raise a glass in someone's honor, especially an older or senior person.

phrases.zh: 感谢刘总一直以来的关照！
phrases.py: Gǎnxiè Liú zǒng yìzhí yǐlái de guānzhào!
phrases.ru: Thank you, Mr. Liu, for your constant support!

phrases.py: Zhù gōngsī yuè lái yuè hǎo!

phrases.zh: 祝大家新年快乐，工作顺利！
phrases.py: Zhù dàjiā xīnnián kuàilè, gōngzuò shùnlì!
phrases.ru: Happy New Year to everyone, and best wishes for your work!

phrases.note: Literally “dry glass”; in the business world it often means really drinking it all.

phrases.ru: I'll drink it all, and you drink as much as you like.
phrases.note: Polite toward someone senior: you show respect without forcing them to drink.

phrases.ru: Drink as much as you like (no obligation).

phrases.zh: 我不太能喝，以茶代酒敬您。
phrases.py: Wǒ bú tài néng hē, yǐ chá dài jiǔ jìng nín.
phrases.ru: I don't hold my alcohol well, allow me to raise tea to you instead.

phrases.zh: 我今天开车了，不能喝酒。
phrases.py: Wǒ jīntiān kāichē le, bù néng hē jiǔ.
phrases.ru: I'm driving today, I can't drink.
phrases.note: The most reliable reason: penalties for drunk driving in China are very strict.

phrases.py: Wǒ zài jìng dàjiā yì bēi!
phrases.ru: I'll drink to everyone once more!

phrases.note: For example, letting a senior person go ahead to a dish or a seat.

phrases.py: Wǒ lái gěi dàjiā dào chá.
phrases.ru: Let me pour tea for everyone.
phrases.note: Juniors pour for seniors; in return they can tap their fingers on the table as a sign of thanks.

phrases.zh: 这道菜很有特色，叫什么名字？
phrases.py: Zhè dào cài hěn yǒu tèsè, jiào shénme míngzi?
phrases.ru: This dish is very distinctive, what is it called?

phrases.zh: 今天吃得太开心了，谢谢领导请客！
phrases.py: Jīntiān chī de tài kāixīn le, xièxie lǐngdǎo qǐngkè!
phrases.ru: Today was wonderful, thank you to the management for treating us!
Will there be a raffle at this year's annual party?

dialogue.zh: 大家辛苦一年了，今天放开吃！
dialogue.py: Dàjiā xīnkǔ yì nián le, jīntiān fàngkāi chī!
dialogue.ru: Everyone worked hard all year, so eat to your heart's content today!

dialogue.zh: 刘总，我敬您一杯。感谢您这一年的关照！
dialogue.py: Liú zǒng, wǒ jìng nín yì bēi. Gǎnxiè nín zhè yì nián de guānzhào!
dialogue.ru: Liu zong, allow me to drink to you. Thank you for your support this year!

dialogue.zh: 哎，客气了。你这一年表现很好。来，干杯！
dialogue.py: Āi, kèqi le. Nǐ zhè yì nián biǎoxiàn hěn hǎo. Lái, gānbēi!
dialogue.ru: Oh, not at all. You did great work this year. Come on, bottoms up!

dialogue.zh: 我不太能喝，以茶代酒，我干了，您随意！
dialogue.py: Wǒ bú tài néng hē, yǐ chá dài jiǔ, wǒ gān le, nín suíyì!
dialogue.ru: I don't hold my alcohol well, allow me to use tea instead of wine: I'll drink it all, and you drink as you like!

dialogue.zh: 没关系，心意到了就行。
dialogue.py: Méi guānxi, xīnyì dào le jiù xíng.
dialogue.ru: No problem, what matters is the thought.

dialogue.zh: 祝公司明年越来越好，也祝您身体健康！
dialogue.py: Zhù gōngsī míngnián yuè lái yuè hǎo, yě zhù nín shēntǐ jiànkāng!
dialogue.ru: I wish the company even greater success next year, and you good health!

dialogue.zh: 好！大家一起来，干杯！
dialogue.py: Hǎo! Dàjiā yìqǐ lái, gānbēi!
dialogue.ru: Great! Everyone together, bottoms up!

dialogue.zh: 这道菜很有特色，叫什么名字？
dialogue.py: Zhè dào cài hěn yǒu tèsè, jiào shénme míngzi?
dialogue.ru: What an interesting dish, what is it called?

dialogue.zh: 这是我们老家的松鼠鳜鱼，你尝尝。
dialogue.py: Zhè shì wǒmen lǎojiā de sōngshǔ guìyú, nǐ chángchang.
dialogue.ru: It's squirrel fish from my hometown, try it.

topics.culture: At a round table the seat of honor is the one facing the door, taken by the host or the most senior person; don't sit down until you're shown your seat. When clinking glasses with a senior person, hold your glass slightly lower than theirs: it's a sign of respect. The culture of “getting everyone drunk” has noticeably weakened in recent years, especially in IT and among young people: saying “以茶代酒” or “我开车了” is absolutely normal, but you should still give a toast. Before Spring Festival almost everywhere there's a 年会, with department performances, awards, and a raffle (抽奖); newcomers are often asked to sing or perform, so it's best to have a couple of phrases or a song in reserve.

quiz.q: How do you politely decline alcohol but still join in a toast?
options: 我不太能喝，以茶代酒敬您。
quiz.explain: 以茶代酒 means to raise tea instead of alcohol; it's polite and accepted.

quiz.q: What does “我干了，您随意” mean?
options: I drink it all, and you drink as much as you like
quiz.explain: You show respect without forcing a senior person to drain the glass.

quiz.q: How should you hold your glass when clinking with your boss?
quiz.explain: Holding your glass lower is a sign of respect for a senior person.

quiz.q: What is 年会?
options: The annual company party before the New Year
quiz.explain: 年会 is a big company celebration with performances and a raffle.

role.ai_role: General manager Liu at a department dinner in a restaurant in Hangzhou, cheerful, offering to drink baijiu
role.user_goal: give a toast to the director and the company, politely decline strong alcohol, and keep up a conversation about the dishes
role.opening: 来来来，大家都坐！今天高兴，先喝一杯白酒！小伙子/小姑娘，你也来一杯？
checklist: Gave a toast with 敬 and thanks (关照)
Politely declined strong alcohol (以茶代酒 / 开车了)
Wished the company success (越来越好)
Kept up the conversation about the food or thanked them for the treat

topics.title: Hierarchy, 面子, and Polite Refusal
topics.intro: In a Chinese office a direct “no” sounds rude, especially to a senior person. You'll learn to refuse and disagree while saving face, yours and theirs, to respond to compliments, to pass a decision up to management, and to understand a “no” disguised as “I'll think about it.”

phrases.zh: 这个我得请示一下领导。
phrases.py: Zhège wǒ děi qǐngshì yíxià lǐngdǎo.
phrases.ru: I need to clear this with management.
phrases.note: A handy way not to say “no” yourself.

phrases.zh: 我考虑一下，再给您答复。
phrases.py: Wǒ kǎolǜ yíxià, zài gěi nín dáfù.
phrases.ru: I'll think about it and give you an answer.
phrases.note: Often this is a polite “probably not.”
Almost always means “no.”
No promise of a result.

phrases.zh: 不好意思，这周我手上的事情比较多。
phrases.py: Bù hǎoyìsi, zhè zhōu wǒ shǒu shang de shìqing bǐjiào duō.
phrases.ru: Sorry, I have a lot on my plate this week.
How about we try a different way?

phrases.py: Nín shuō de duì, wǒ zài xiǎngxiang.
phrases.ru: You're right, I'll think about it some more.

phrases.note: A polite refusal of an invitation.

phrases.py: Nǎli nǎli, hái chà de yuǎn ne.
phrases.ru: Not at all, I'm still far from that.
phrases.note: A modest reply to a compliment.

phrases.py: Lǐngdǎo, nín kàn zhèyàng xíng bu xíng?
phrases.ru: Boss, what do you think, would this work?
phrases.note: Proposing a solution in the form of a question leaves the decision to the senior person.

phrases.zh: 这件事我们私下聊聊吧。
phrases.py: Zhè jiàn shì wǒmen sīxià liáoliao ba.

phrases.note: When accepting praise in public, share it with the team.

dialogue.zh: 小安，周六客户来考察，你来陪一下吧？
dialogue.py: Xiǎo Ān, zhōuliù kèhù lái kǎochá, nǐ lái péi yíxià ba?
dialogue.ru: Xiao An, a client is coming on Saturday, can you accompany him?

dialogue.zh: 张总，不好意思，这周六上午我已经约了医生复查，可能有点难度。
dialogue.py: Zhāng zǒng, bù hǎoyìsi, zhè zhōuliù shàngwǔ wǒ yǐjīng yuē le yīshēng fùchá, kěnéng yǒudiǎn nándù.
dialogue.ru: Zhang zong, sorry, I've already booked a follow-up appointment with the doctor for this Saturday morning, so it won't be easy.

dialogue.zh: 哦，那确实重要。客户只会说俄语，有点麻烦。
dialogue.py: Ò, nà quèshí zhòngyào. Kèhù zhǐ huì shuō Éyǔ, yǒudiǎn máfan.
dialogue.ru: Ah, that's really important. The client speaks only Russian, that's the difficulty.

dialogue.zh: 我理解您的难处。要不这样：我上午看完医生，下午过来陪客户，您看行不行？
dialogue.py: Wǒ lǐjiě nín de nánchù. Yàobù zhèyàng: wǒ shàngwǔ kàn wán yīshēng, xiàwǔ guòlai péi kèhù, nín kàn xíng bu xíng?
dialogue.ru: I understand your difficulties. How about this: I'll see the doctor in the morning and come to the client after lunch. What do you think?

dialogue.zh: 太好了，就这么定。上次的俄罗斯订单你做得很好啊。
dialogue.py: Tài hǎo le, jiù zhème dìng. Shàng cì de Éluósī dìngdān nǐ zuò de hěn hǎo a.
dialogue.ru: Great, let's do that. By the way, you did a great job with the last Russian order.

dialogue.zh: 您过奖了，都是大家的功劳。
dialogue.py: Nín guòjiǎng le, dōu shì dàjiā de gōngláo.
dialogue.ru: You flatter me, it's the achievement of the whole team.

dialogue.zh: 对了，晚上一起吃个饭吧？
dialogue.py: Duì le, wǎnshang yìqǐ chī ge fàn ba?
dialogue.ru: Yes, by the way, how about having dinner together this evening?

dialogue.zh: 谢谢张总！这周实在走不开，下次有机会一定！
dialogue.py: Xièxie Zhāng zǒng! Zhè zhōu shízài zǒu bu kāi, xià cì yǒu jīhuì yídìng!
dialogue.ru: Thank you, Zhang zong! This week I really can't, next time for sure!

topics.culture: 面子 is a person's public reputation and dignity; to hurt it (criticizing someone in front of everyone, arguing with your boss in front of the team, refusing bluntly) is a serious mistake. That's why “no” in China sounds like 有点难度, 我考虑一下, 研究研究, or 我尽量: learn to hear such refusals and use them yourself. A good refusal pattern: apology → reason → understanding (我理解…) → an alternative in the form of a question (您看行不行？). Compliments are customarily answered modestly (哪里哪里, 您过奖了), not with “thanks, I know.” Criticism of subordinates and colleagues is given in private, while praise is given in public.

quiz.q: A Chinese partner says: “这个可能有点难度.” What does he most likely mean?
quiz.explain: 有点难度 is a typical polite “no.”

quiz.q: Your boss praises you in front of everyone. What is the best reply?
options: 您过奖了，都是大家的功劳。
quiz.explain: Modesty and sharing credit with the team save face for everyone.

quiz.q: Which pattern for politely refusing your boss is best?
options: Apologize, explain, and offer an alternative as a question
quiz.explain: An apology + a reason + an alternative (您看行不行) is a refusal without losing face.

quiz.q: What does “这个我得请示一下领导” mean?
options: I need to clear this with management
quiz.explain: 请示 means to ask management for instructions; a handy way not to say “no” yourself.

role.ai_role: Director Zhang, a respected senior manager who is used to not being refused but values sensible alternatives
role.user_goal: politely decline urgent work on Sunday without making the director lose face, offer an alternative, and modestly answer a compliment
role.opening: 小伙伴，这个周日有个紧急项目，你来加个班吧？你中文好，非你不可啊！
checklist: Didn't say a flat “不行” and apologized
Gave the reason and expressed understanding (我理解…)
Offered an alternative in the form of a question (您看行不行？)
Modestly answered the compliment (过奖 / 哪里哪里)

tracks.title: Business with China
tracks.ru: Business Chinese for importers: from the first message to a supplier to a complaint about defects, logistics, and a business dinner.

topics.title: First Contact with a Supplier
topics.intro: The first message or call to a supplier decides whether you'll be treated as a serious buyer. We'll learn to introduce your company and volumes, find out whether you're dealing with a factory or an intermediary, and move the conversation to WeChat.

phrases.zh: 您好，我是俄罗斯ABC贸易公司的采购经理，我叫安德烈。
phrases.py: Nín hǎo, wǒ shì Éluósī ABC màoyì gōngsī de cǎigòu jīnglǐ, wǒ jiào Āndéliè.
phrases.ru: Hello, I'm the purchasing manager of the Russian company ABC Trading, my name is Andrei.
phrases.note: Immediately state your country, company, and position: that way you're seen as a B2B client.

phrases.zh: 我们主要做家居用品的进口和批发。
phrases.py: Wǒmen zhǔyào zuò jiājū yòngpǐn de jìnkǒu hé pīfā.
phrases.ru: We mainly import and wholesale household goods.

phrases.zh: 请问你们是工厂还是贸易公司？
phrases.py: Qǐngwèn nǐmen shì gōngchǎng háishi màoyì gōngsī?
phrases.ru: May I ask, are you a factory or a trading company?
phrases.note: The main question of first contact: the price and quality control depend on the answer.
A polite way to ask someone's name; then address them as “surname + 经理/总.”

phrases.ru: Could you tell me who is in charge of foreign trade at your company?

phrases.zh: 我们每年的采购量在五十万美元左右。
phrases.py: Wǒmen měi nián de cǎigòuliàng zài wǔshí wàn Měiyuán zuǒyòu.
phrases.ru: Our annual purchasing volume is around 500 thousand US dollars.
phrases.note: State the real order of magnitude: exaggeration is quickly exposed.

phrases.zh: 能发一下你们的产品目录和价格表吗？
phrases.py: Néng fā yíxià nǐmen de chǎnpǐn mùlù hé jiàgébiǎo ma?
phrases.ru: Could you send a catalog and a price list?
Is it convenient to add each other on WeChat?
phrases.note: In China, work communication with suppliers most often goes through WeChat; email is for official documents.

phrases.zh: 你们有出口俄罗斯的经验吗？
phrases.py: Nǐmen yǒu chūkǒu Éluósī de jīngyàn ma?
phrases.ru: Do you have experience exporting to Russia?

phrases.py: Nǐmen yǒu nǎxiē rènzhèng? Bǐrú EAC, CE.
phrases.ru: What certificates do you have? For example, EAC, CE.
phrases.note: EAC is the EAEU conformity mark; ask in advance who will handle obtaining it.

phrases.zh: 你们工厂在哪里？可以安排验厂吗？
phrases.py: Nǐmen gōngchǎng zài nǎlǐ? Kěyǐ ānpái yànchǎng ma?
phrases.ru: Where is your factory? Can a factory audit be arranged?

phrases.zh: 我们先小批量试单，没问题的话再加量。
phrases.py: Wǒmen xiān xiǎo pīliàng shìdān, méi wèntí dehuà zài jiāliàng.
phrases.ru: We'll first place a small trial order, and if everything is fine, we'll increase the volume.

phrases.zh: 我们希望建立长期合作关系。
phrases.py: Wǒmen xīwàng jiànlì chángqī hézuò guānxì.
phrases.ru: We hope to build a long-term partnership.

dialogue.zh: 您好，这里是宁波恒达家居，请问有什么可以帮您？
dialogue.py: Nín hǎo, zhèlǐ shì Níngbō Héngdá Jiājū, qǐngwèn yǒu shénme kěyǐ bāng nín?
dialogue.ru: Hello, this is Hengda Home, Ningbo. How can I help you?

dialogue.zh: 您好，我是俄罗斯一家贸易公司的采购，我叫安德烈。我们在找收纳盒的供应商。
dialogue.py: Nín hǎo, wǒ shì Éluósī yì jiā màoyì gōngsī de cǎigòu, wǒ jiào Āndéliè. Wǒmen zài zhǎo shōunàhé de gōngyìngshāng.
dialogue.ru: Hello, I'm a buyer for a Russian trading company, my name is Andrei. We're looking for a supplier of storage boxes.

dialogue.zh: 欢迎欢迎！我们是工厂，在宁波有自己的生产线，做了十多年了。
dialogue.py: Huānyíng huānyíng! Wǒmen shì gōngchǎng, zài Níngbō yǒu zìjǐ de shēngchǎnxiàn, zuò le shí duō nián le.
dialogue.ru: Welcome! We're a factory, we have our own production line in Ningbo, and we've been operating for more than ten years.

dialogue.zh: 你们有出口俄罗斯的经验吗？
dialogue.py: Nǐmen yǒu chūkǒu Éluósī de jīngyàn ma?
dialogue.ru: Do you have experience exporting to Russia?

dialogue.zh: 有的，我们有好几个俄罗斯客户，主要发莫斯科和新西伯利亚。
dialogue.py: Yǒu de, wǒmen yǒu hǎo jǐ ge Éluósī kèhù, zhǔyào fā Mòsīkē hé Xīnxībólìyà.
dialogue.ru: We do, we have several Russian clients, and we ship mainly to Moscow and Novosibirsk.

dialogue.zh: 太好了。能发一下产品目录和价格表吗？
dialogue.py: Tài hǎo le. Néng fā yíxià chǎnpǐn mùlù hé jiàgébiǎo ma?
dialogue.ru: Great. Could you send a catalog and a price list?

dialogue.zh: 没问题。方便加个微信吗？我把资料发给您。
dialogue.py: Méi wèntí. Fāngbiàn jiā ge Wēixìn ma? Wǒ bǎ zīliào fā gěi nín.
dialogue.ru: No problem. Is it convenient to add each other on WeChat? I'll send the materials.

dialogue.zh: 好的，我扫您。我们先小批量试单，合作顺利的话会长期下单。
dialogue.py: Hǎo de, wǒ sǎo nín. Wǒmen xiān xiǎo pīliàng shìdān, hézuò shùnlì dehuà huì chángqī xiàdān.
dialogue.ru: Okay, I'll scan your code. We'll start with a trial order, and if all goes well, we'll order regularly.

topics.culture: Business communication with Chinese suppliers most often goes through WeChat: email is read less often, and voice messages and video calls are the norm. Many “factories” are actually trading companies; ask for a video call from the workshop and a copy of the license (营业执照), and check the company's details and scope of business (经营范围) in the official system gsxt.gov.cn (国家企业信用信息公示系统): for a manufacturer, production (生产) is usually listed there. People are addressed by surname and title: 王经理, 李总 (for an owner or director). A Chinese name on your business card and in your WeChat profile makes introductions and being remembered easier.

quiz.q: How do you ask: “Are you a factory or a trading company?”
options: 你们是工厂还是贸易公司？
你们是工厂或者贸易公司？
quiz.explain: In a question with a choice, “or” is 还是; 或者 is used in statements.

quiz.q: What is the main channel of communication with a Chinese supplier in 2026?
quiz.explain: Chinese managers do their messaging, files, calls, and even payments in WeChat.

quiz.q: What does 试单 mean?
quiz.explain: 试单 is a small first order to test a supplier.

quiz.q: How do you respectfully address a factory owner whose surname is Wang?
quiz.explain: 总 (from 总经理/老总) is a form of address for a manager; 小王 is familiar, for juniors.

role.ai_role: a sales manager at a plastic organizer factory in Ningbo: polite but cautious, first checks whether the buyer is serious, and in no hurry to give the best prices
role.user_goal: introduce your company and volumes, find out whether it is a factory or a trader, ask about experience exporting to Russia and certificates, get a catalog, and add each other on WeChat
role.opening: 您好，这里是恒达家居，我是销售小林。请问您是哪家公司的？之前跟我们合作过吗？
checklist: Introduced yourself: name, company, country, position
Named your line of business and approximate purchase volume
Asked whether it is a factory or a trading company, and about an audit/video call from the workshop
Asked about experience exporting to Russia or about certificates
Requested a catalog/price list and arranged contact on WeChat

topics.title: 1688 and Taobao: Price and Specifications
topics.intro: On 1688 (wholesale) and Taobao (retail) you haggle in a chat with the seller, briefly and quickly. We'll learn to ask about availability, price by volume, material, dimensions, packaging, and delivery to a warehouse in China.

phrases.note: The standard way to start a conversation with a seller on 1688/Taobao.

phrases.py: Ná wǔbǎi ge shì shénme jiàgé?
phrases.ru: What's the price if I take 500 pieces?
phrases.note: 拿 in sellers' chats means “to take, to purchase.”

phrases.ru: Can I mix models/colors in one wholesale batch?
What are the dimensions and weight?

phrases.zh: 一箱装多少个？外箱尺寸是多少？
phrases.py: Yì xiāng zhuāng duōshao ge? Wàixiāng chǐcùn shì duōshao?
phrases.ru: How many pieces are in a carton? What are the dimensions of the shipping carton?
phrases.note: Without this information you can't calculate shipping.

phrases.py: Néng fā jǐ zhāng shípāitú ma?
phrases.ru: Can you send a few real photos?
phrases.note: 实拍图 means real photos of the product, not advertising renders.

phrases.py: Kěyǐ yìn wǒmen de logo ma?

phrases.ru: How many days after ordering is it shipped?

phrases.zh: 我们的货发到广州的仓库。
phrases.py: Wǒmen de huò fā dào Guǎngzhōu de cāngkù.
phrases.ru: Send our goods to the warehouse in Guangzhou.
phrases.note: This is usually the warehouse of your buying agent or cargo company.
含税 means the price includes Chinese VAT (增值税, 13% for most goods) and an official invoice 发票. A foreign buyer usually doesn't need a 发票, so compare prices on the same basis: 含税 or 不含税.

dialogue.zh: 在吗？这款硅胶收纳袋有现货吗？
dialogue.py: Zài ma? Zhè kuǎn guījiāo shōunàdài yǒu xiànhuò ma?
dialogue.ru: Hello! Is this silicone storage bag in stock?

dialogue.zh: 亲，在的！现货充足，四十八小时内发货。
dialogue.py: Qīn, zài de! Xiànhuò chōngzú, sìshíbā xiǎoshí nèi fāhuò.
dialogue.ru: Yes, I'm here! Plenty in stock, shipping within 48 hours.

dialogue.zh: 拿一千个是什么价格？
dialogue.py: Ná yìqiān ge shì shénme jiàgé?
dialogue.ru: What's the price per 1,000 pieces?

dialogue.zh: 一千个的话是三块二一个，不含税。
dialogue.py: Yìqiān ge dehuà shì sān kuài èr yí ge, bù hán shuì.
dialogue.ru: For a thousand, it's 3.2 yuan each, without tax.

dialogue.zh: 材质是什么？有没有食品级的检测报告？
dialogue.py: Cáizhì shì shénme? Yǒu méiyǒu shípǐnjí de jiǎncè bàogào?
dialogue.ru: What is it made of? Is there a food-contact test report?

dialogue.zh: 是食品级硅胶，有SGS报告，我发给您看。
dialogue.py: Shì shípǐnjí guījiāo, yǒu SGS bàogào, wǒ fā gěi nín kàn.
dialogue.ru: Food-grade silicone, there's an SGS report, I'll send it now.

dialogue.zh: 支持混批吗？我想要三个颜色。
dialogue.py: Zhīchí hùnpī ma? Wǒ xiǎng yào sān ge yánsè.
dialogue.ru: Can I mix? I want three colors.

dialogue.zh: 支持的，每个颜色最少三百个就行。
dialogue.py: Zhīchí de, měi ge yánsè zuìshǎo sānbǎi ge jiù xíng.
dialogue.ru: Yes, the minimum is 300 pieces of each color.

dialogue.zh: 好，我们的货发到广州的仓库，运费怎么算？
dialogue.py: Hǎo, wǒmen de huò fā dào Guǎngzhōu de cāngkù, yùnfèi zěnme suàn?
dialogue.ru: Okay. Our goods go to the warehouse in Guangzhou, how is shipping calculated?

dialogue.zh: 广州的话走快递，大概一百二十块，下单的时候我帮您改价。
dialogue.py: Guǎngzhōu dehuà zǒu kuàidì, dàgài yìbǎi èrshí kuài, xiàdān de shíhou wǒ bāng nín gǎijià.
dialogue.ru: To Guangzhou by express delivery, about 120 yuan; I'll adjust the price when you place the order.

topics.culture: 1688 is Alibaba's wholesale platform with prices depending on the batch size (起批量), and Taobao is retail; wholesale prices on 1688 are usually lower than retail ones. Sellers call the buyer 亲 (“dear”), and that is ordinary politeness, not overfamiliarity. The phrase 我帮您改价 means the seller will manually change the order amount before payment; that's how shipping or a discount is included in the final price. Many stores marked “factory” (源头工厂) are in fact resellers: compare the prices of several sellers and ask for real photos and videos. 1688 has an official app for foreign buyers, 1688 Global (developer 1688.COM PTE. LTD., Alibaba Group), but the available countries, payment methods, and delivery options in it may change, so check in the app itself. Many buyers from Russia work through a buying agent or a cargo company with a warehouse in Guangzhou or Yiwu; clarify who is responsible for recounting and defects at the warehouse.

quiz.q: What does 现货 mean?
quiz.explain: 现货 means ready goods in the warehouse, shipped immediately.

quiz.q: A seller writes “亲.” What is it?
options: A familiarity that signals a refusal
An ordinary polite form of address from a seller to a buyer
quiz.explain: 亲 is the standard form of address in Chinese online trade.

quiz.q: What does 混批 mean?
options: Mixing different models/colors in one wholesale batch
A wholesale price for only one model
Mixed payment: part by card, part in cash
quiz.explain: 混批 is a mixed batch; each seller has their own minimum per item.

quiz.q: How do you ask for the dimensions of the shipping carton?
quiz.explain: 外箱 means the outer (master) carton, 尺寸 means dimensions.

role.ai_role: a seller at a 1688 store (actually a trading company, but calling itself a factory), who replies briefly in chat style, calls the buyer 亲, and dodges awkward questions
role.user_goal: find out the price for 1,000 pieces, the material, the packaging (pieces per carton, carton size and weight), the possibility of printing a logo, and the shipping time to the warehouse in Guangzhou, and also work out whether it is a factory or an intermediary
role.opening: 亲，在的～请问需要什么款式？拿货量大概多少？
checklist: Asked the price for a specific quantity
Clarified the material and asked for real photos or a test report
Found out the quantity per carton and the carton's dimensions/weight
Asked about the logo and the shipping time
Found out whether it is a factory (or asked for confirmation)

topics.title: Samples and Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)
topics.intro: Before paying for a batch you need samples, and a factory's minimum order is often larger than what you need. We'll learn to request samples, agree on who pays for them, and lower the MOQ with a sensible compromise.

phrases.ru: What is your minimum order quantity?
phrases.note: 起订量 (or 最小起订量) means MOQ.

phrases.zh: 每个颜色的起订量是多少？
phrases.py: Měi ge yánsè de qǐdìngliàng shì duōshao?
phrases.ru: What is the minimum for each color?

phrases.zh: 这个起订量太高了，能不能少一点？
phrases.py: Zhège qǐdìngliàng tài gāo le, néng bu néng shǎo yìdiǎn?
phrases.ru: This minimum is too high, can it be lower?

phrases.zh: 第一单我们只能下五百个。
phrases.py: Dì-yī dān wǒmen zhǐ néng xià wǔbǎi ge.
phrases.ru: For the first order we can only order 500 pieces.

phrases.zh: 如果数量少，价格可以高一点。
phrases.py: Rúguǒ shùliàng shǎo, jiàgé kěyǐ gāo yìdiǎn.
phrases.ru: If the quantity is smaller, the price can be a bit higher.
phrases.note: The best compromise: the factory cares about profit, not the MOQ figure itself.

phrases.py: Dìngzhì logo de qǐdìngliàng yíyàng ma?
phrases.ru: Is the minimum the same with a logo print?

phrases.py: Néng bu néng xiān jì yàngpǐn?

phrases.zh: 样品费下大货的时候可以退吗？
phrases.py: Yàngpǐnfèi xià dàhuò de shíhou kěyǐ tuì ma?
phrases.ru: Will the sample cost be refunded when we place the bulk order?
phrases.note: 大货 means the main (bulk) batch.

phrases.zh: 国际快递费我们来付，请告诉我金额。
phrases.py: Guójì kuàidìfèi wǒmen lái fù, qǐng gàosu wǒ jīn'é.
phrases.ru: We'll pay for the international shipping, please tell me the amount.
How long until the samples are ready?

phrases.zh: 请把样品寄到这个地址。
phrases.py: Qǐng bǎ yàngpǐn jì dào zhège dìzhǐ.
phrases.ru: Please send the samples to this address.
We need to approve a pre-production sample.

phrases.zh: 这个样品我们留作封样。
phrases.ru: We'll keep this sample as the sealed reference sample.
phrases.note: 封样 is a signed reference sample; the basis for acceptance and claims.

phrases.zh: 请按照样品的标准生产大货。
phrases.py: Qǐng ànzhào yàngpǐn de biāozhǔn shēngchǎn dàhuò.
phrases.ru: Please produce the bulk order to the standard of the sample.

dialogue.zh: 王经理，这款保温杯你们的起订量是多少？
dialogue.py: Wáng jīnglǐ, zhè kuǎn bǎowēnbēi nǐmen de qǐdìngliàng shì duōshao?
dialogue.ru: Manager Wang, what is your minimum order for this thermos mug?

dialogue.zh: 印logo的话，起订量是三千个。
dialogue.py: Yìn logo dehuà, qǐdìngliàng shì sānqiān ge.
dialogue.ru: With a logo, the minimum is 3,000 pieces.

dialogue.zh: 三千个太多了，第一单我们只能下一千个。
dialogue.py: Sānqiān ge tài duō le, dì-yī dān wǒmen zhǐ néng xià yìqiān ge.
dialogue.ru: 3,000 is too many, for the first order we can only order 1,000.

dialogue.zh: 一千个也可以做，但是单价要加两块，因为开机和印刷的成本是一样的。
dialogue.py: Yìqiān ge yě kěyǐ zuò, dànshì dānjià yào jiā liǎng kuài, yīnwèi kāijī hé yìnshuā de chéngběn shì yíyàng de.
dialogue.ru: We can do 1,000 too, but the price per piece is +2 yuan: the setup and printing costs are the same.

dialogue.zh: 可以理解。能不能先寄样品？
dialogue.py: Kěyǐ lǐjiě. Néng bu néng xiān jì yàngpǐn?
dialogue.ru: Understood. Can you send samples first?

dialogue.zh: 现有款式的样品免费，运费您这边承担。定制logo的样品收三百元，下大货的时候退给您。
dialogue.py: Xiànyǒu kuǎnshì de yàngpǐn miǎnfèi, yùnfèi nín zhèbiān chéngdān. Dìngzhì logo de yàngpǐn shōu sānbǎi yuán, xià dàhuò de shíhou tuì gěi nín.
dialogue.ru: Samples of existing models are free, shipping at your expense. A sample with a logo is 300 yuan, refunded when you order the batch.

dialogue.zh: 好的。样品多久能做好？
dialogue.py: Hǎo de. Yàngpǐn duōjiǔ néng zuòhǎo?
dialogue.ru: Okay. How long until the samples are ready?

dialogue.zh: 现货样品明天就能寄，定制的大概七天。走国际快递到莫斯科大概七到十天。
dialogue.py: Xiànhuò yàngpǐn míngtiān jiù néng jì, dìngzhì de dàgài qī tiān. Zǒu guójì kuàidì dào Mòsīkē dàgài qī dào shí tiān.
dialogue.ru: Stock ones we'll ship tomorrow, ones with a logo take about 7 days. By international express to Moscow, about 7–10 days.

topics.culture: MOQ is almost always negotiable: it's made up of setup costs and the minimum purchase of raw materials and printing, so in exchange for a smaller run it's reasonable to accept a slightly higher price or a stock color. Samples of ready-made models are often free, but the buyer pays for shipping; samples with a logo are usually paid, and the cost is credited when you order the batch. It's convenient to send samples to the warehouse of your cargo company or buying agent in China and forward them along with other shipments. Keep the approved sample as a 封样 with the signature or photo of both sides: without a reference sample it's almost impossible to prove a defect. Remember that the sample may have been made by hand better than the mass-produced item, so check the first batch too.

quiz.q: What does 起订量 mean?
quiz.explain: 起订量 = MOQ, minimum order quantity.

quiz.q: What is 大货?
quiz.explain: 大货 is contrasted with 样品 (a sample).

quiz.q: A factory's MOQ with a logo is 3,000 pcs, but you need 1,000. What is the most workable strategy?
options: Demand the same price for 1,000 pieces
Offer a smaller run at a higher price per piece, or a stock model
Refuse right away and look for another factory
quiz.explain: The factory needs to cover its setup costs; a surcharge for a small run is a fair trade.

quiz.q: What is 封样?
options: A sample that is sent back to the factory
A reference sample kept as the quality standard for the batch
quiz.explain: The batch is accepted and claims are made against the 封样.

role.ai_role: a manager at a thermos mug factory in Yongkang (Zhejiang): firmly holds to an MOQ of 3,000 pieces with a logo, cites setup and printing costs, but is ready to compromise for a surcharge
role.user_goal: agree on a first order of 1,000 pieces with a logo on acceptable terms, get samples, and get the cost of the logo sample credited when you order the batch
role.opening: 您好！我看了您的询盘，您要的是五百毫升的保温杯，对吧？印logo的话我们起订量是三千个哦。
checklist: Explained why you need a smaller run (a trial order, growing volumes)
Proposed a compromise: a surcharge per piece, a stock color, or orders in stages
Requested samples and found out their cost and timing
Agreed that the sample cost will be credited when the batch is ordered
Recorded that the batch is made to the approved sample (封样)

topics.title: Haggling: Price and Volume Discounts
topics.intro: A supplier's first price almost always has a cushion built in. We'll learn to haggle politely but firmly: refer to competitors, ask for tiered pricing by volume, and trade concessions without losing face.

phrases.zh: 这个价格有点高，还有优惠空间吗？
phrases.py: Zhège jiàgé yǒudiǎn gāo, hái yǒu yōuhuì kōngjiān ma?
phrases.ru: The price is a bit high, is there still room for a discount?

phrases.py: Néng gěi ge shízài jià ma?
phrases.ru: Can you give me a real price?
phrases.note: 实在价 means an honest price without a “haggling cushion.”

phrases.zh: 别家报价比你们低百分之十。
phrases.py: Biéjiā bàojià bǐ nǐmen dī bǎi fēn zhī shí.
phrases.ru: Other suppliers quote 10% lower than you.
phrases.note: Refer to competitors without accusations: this saves face.

phrases.zh: 如果我们订五千个，单价能降到多少？
phrases.py: Rúguǒ wǒmen dìng wǔqiān ge, dānjià néng jiàng dào duōshao?
phrases.ru: If we order 5,000 pieces, how low will the unit price go?

phrases.zh: 能不能按阶梯价报一下？
phrases.py: Néng bu néng àn jiētījià bào yíxià?
phrases.ru: Can you quote tiered prices by volume?

phrases.zh: 我们是长期客户，以后量会越来越大。
phrases.py: Wǒmen shì chángqī kèhù, yǐhòu liàng huì yuè lái yuè dà.
phrases.ru: We're a long-term customer, and volumes will keep growing.

phrases.zh: 价格不能降的话，能不能免费升级包装？
phrases.py: Jiàgé bù néng jiàng dehuà, néng bu néng miǎnfèi shēngjí bāozhuāng?
phrases.ru: If the price can't be lowered, could you upgrade the packaging for free?
phrases.note: Haggle over more than the price: packaging, timing, payment terms.

phrases.zh: 这已经是我们的最低价了。
phrases.py: Zhè yǐjīng shì wǒmen de zuìdī jià le.
phrases.ru: This is already our lowest price.
phrases.note: A typical supplier phrase; often not yet the last word.

phrases.zh: 我需要跟老板商量一下。
phrases.py: Wǒ xūyào gēn lǎobǎn shāngliang yíxià.
phrases.ru: I need to discuss it with my boss.
phrases.note: A classic pause in haggling; both sides use it.

phrases.ru: Have raw materials gone up in price?
How long is the quote valid?

phrases.zh: 如果今天能定下来，我们马上付定金。
phrases.py: Rúguǒ jīntiān néng dìng xiàlai, wǒmen mǎshàng fù dìngjīn.
phrases.ru: If we can settle today, we'll pay the deposit right away.

phrases.py: Wǒmen gè ràng yí bù ba.

dialogue.zh: 李经理，你们报的八块五我们觉得有点高，还有优惠空间吗？
dialogue.py: Lǐ jīnglǐ, nǐmen bào de bā kuài wǔ wǒmen juéde yǒudiǎn gāo, hái yǒu yōuhuì kōngjiān ma?
dialogue.ru: Manager Li, your 8.5 yuan is a bit high for us. Is there a possibility of a discount?

dialogue.zh: 安德烈，这个价格真的很实在了，现在原材料一直在涨。
dialogue.py: Āndéliè, zhège jiàgé zhēn de hěn shízài le, xiànzài yuáncáiliào yìzhí zài zhǎng.
dialogue.ru: Andrei, the price is really honest, raw materials keep getting more expensive.

dialogue.zh: 我理解，但是别家报价是七块八，质量也差不多。
dialogue.py: Wǒ lǐjiě, dànshì biéjiā bàojià shì qī kuài bā, zhìliàng yě chàbuduō.
dialogue.ru: I understand, but others have 7.8, and the quality is about the same.

dialogue.zh: 便宜的我们也能做，但用的不是新料。
dialogue.py: Piányi de wǒmen yě néng zuò, dàn yòng de bú shì xīnliào.
dialogue.ru: We can go cheaper too, but then not from virgin material.

dialogue.zh: 如果我们订五千个，单价能降到多少？
dialogue.py: Rúguǒ wǒmen dìng wǔqiān ge, dānjià néng jiàng dào duōshao?
dialogue.ru: If we order 5,000, how low will you go?

dialogue.zh: 五千个的话，最低八块，不能再低了。
dialogue.py: Wǔqiān ge dehuà, zuìdī bā kuài, bù néng zài dī le.
dialogue.ru: For 5,000, 8 yuan at the lowest, no lower.

dialogue.zh: 七块六，我们今天就付百分之三十定金。
dialogue.py: Qī kuài liù, wǒmen jīntiān jiù fù bǎi fēn zhī sānshí dìngjīn.
dialogue.ru: 7.6, and we pay a 30% deposit today.

dialogue.zh: 七块六真的做不了。我跟老板商量一下……最多七块八，彩盒包装我们免费升级。
dialogue.py: Qī kuài liù zhēn de zuò bu liǎo. Wǒ gēn lǎobǎn shāngliang yíxià…… Zuìduō qī kuài bā, cǎihé bāozhuāng wǒmen miǎnfèi shēngjí.
dialogue.ru: We really can't do 7.6. I'll consult management… 7.8 at most, and we'll make a color box for free.

dialogue.zh: 好，我们各让一步，那就这么定了。请发一份新的PI。
dialogue.py: Hǎo, wǒmen gè ràng yí bù, nà jiù zhème dìng le. Qǐng fā yí fèn xīn de PI.
dialogue.ru: Okay, each of us gave a little, it's a deal. Please send a new proforma invoice.

topics.culture: The first price usually contains a cushion for haggling, and haggling is expected, but direct accusations (“you're overcharging”) make the other person lose face; it's better to refer to the market and other offers. Trading works best: volume, a quick deposit, or flexible deadlines in exchange for a lower price, packaging, or free samples. If you squeeze the price below cost, the factory often makes up for it with recycled material, thin walls, or weak packaging. Record the final agreement in writing in a PI or contract with a description of the material. Before Chinese New Year and in peak season factories' workloads rise and discounts are harder to get.

quiz.q: What does 优惠空间 mean?
quiz.explain: 优惠 means discount, benefit; 空间 means “room” for it.

quiz.q: A supplier says “我跟老板商量一下.” Most often this is…
options: A pause in haggling; a small concession may come later
A demand to double the volume
quiz.explain: It's a standard move so as not to give in right away and to save face.

quiz.q: Why is it risky to squeeze the price far below the market?
options: The factory is required by law to refuse
The price will automatically rise at shipment
The factory may cut costs on materials and quality
quiz.explain: For example, it will switch to recycled material (not 新料).

quiz.q: What does 阶梯价 mean?
options: A tiered price depending on volume
The price of delivery to your floor
quiz.explain: 阶梯 means “staircase”: the bigger the batch, the lower the price.

role.ai_role: 李总 is the owner of an LED lamp factory in Zhongshan: tough, cites rising raw material prices and the exchange rate, pushes on quality, but is ready to give 3–5% if the buyer offers volume, a quick deposit, or other benefits
role.user_goal: bring the price down from 42 yuan to 38 or lower per set on an order of 2,000 sets, or get equivalent concessions (packaging, timing, spare parts), without spoiling the relationship
role.opening: 您好，报价单已经发您了，四十二块一套已经是很实在的价格了。您这边考虑得怎么样？
checklist: Politely explained why the price is high (the market, other offers), without accusations
Asked for a tiered price or a price for a larger volume
Proposed a trade: volume, a deposit, or timing in exchange for a discount
Clarified that the materials and quality won't change at the new price
Recorded the outcome and asked for an updated PI

topics.title: Payment: Deposit, Balance, and Methods
topics.intro: Payment terms are the buyer's main protection, and payments from Russia to China in 2026 take preparation. We'll learn to discuss the 30/70 scheme, work with a proforma invoice and bank details, and warn about an agent payer.

phrases.zh: 你们的付款方式是什么？
一般是百分之三十定金，百分之七十尾款发货前付清。
phrases.py: Yìbān shì bǎi fēn zhī sānshí dìngjīn, bǎi fēn zhī qīshí wěikuǎn fāhuò qián fùqīng.
phrases.ru: Usually a 30% deposit, with the 70% balance paid in full before shipment.
phrases.note: A common practice (T/T 30/70), not a rule: payment terms are an agreement between the parties, so record them in the contract.

phrases.zh: 能不能改成定金百分之二十？
phrases.py: Néng bu néng gǎichéng dìngjīn bǎi fēn zhī èrshí?

phrases.zh: 尾款能不能见提单副本再付？
phrases.py: Wěikuǎn néng bu néng jiàn tídān fùběn zài fù?
phrases.ru: Can the balance be paid against a copy of the bill of lading?
phrases.note: Better for the buyer: pay when the goods have already been shipped.

phrases.zh: 请先发形式发票（PI）给我们。
phrases.py: Qǐng xiān fā xíngshì fāpiào (PI) gěi wǒmen.
phrases.ru: Please send the proforma invoice (PI) first.

phrases.zh: 我们通过支付代理付款，付款方的名字会不一样。
phrases.py: Wǒmen tōngguò zhīfù dàilǐ fùkuǎn, fùkuǎnfāng de míngzi huì bù yíyàng.
phrases.ru: We pay through a payment agent, the payer's name will be different.
phrases.note: Warn in advance, otherwise the supplier's bank may return the payment.

phrases.zh: 收款账户是公司账户还是个人账户？
phrases.py: Shōukuǎn zhànghù shì gōngsī zhànghù háishi gèrén zhànghù?
phrases.ru: Is the recipient account a corporate or a personal one?

phrases.zh: 请确认一下银行信息：开户行、账号、SWIFT代码。
phrases.py: Qǐng quèrèn yíxià yínháng xìnxī: kāihùháng, zhànghào, SWIFT dàimǎ.
phrases.ru: Please confirm the bank details: bank, account number, SWIFT.

phrases.zh: 账户信息变了的话，必须电话确认。
phrases.py: Zhànghù xìnxī biàn le dehuà, bìxū diànhuà quèrèn.
phrases.ru: If the account details change, we must confirm by phone.
phrases.note: Substituting bank details in emails is a common scam.

phrases.zh: 钱已经汇过去了，这是水单。
phrases.py: Qián yǐjīng huì guoqu le, zhè shì shuǐdān.
phrases.ru: The money has been sent, here is the transfer confirmation.
phrases.note: 水单 means a bank statement/payment confirmation.

phrases.zh: 银行退款了，说要补充材料。
phrases.py: Yínháng tuìkuǎn le, shuō yào bǔchōng cáiliào.
phrases.ru: The bank returned the payment, saying additional documents are needed.

phrases.zh: 小额样品费可以用支付宝付吗？
phrases.py: Xiǎo'é yàngpǐnfèi kěyǐ yòng Zhīfùbǎo fù ma?
phrases.ru: Can I pay a small sample fee through Alipay?
phrases.note: Foreigners can link a foreign card (Visa, Mastercard, etc.) to Alipay and WeChat Pay, but cards from Russian banks may not work, so check in advance.

dialogue.zh: 安德烈，PI已经发您邮箱了，麻烦确认一下。
dialogue.py: Āndéliè, PI yǐjīng fā nín yóuxiāng le, máfan quèrèn yíxià.
dialogue.ru: Andrei, I sent the PI to your email, please confirm.

dialogue.zh: 收到了。付款方式还是三十定金、七十尾款吗？
dialogue.py: Shōudào le. Fùkuǎn fāngshì háishi sānshí dìngjīn, qīshí wěikuǎn ma?
dialogue.ru: Received. The terms are the same: 30% deposit, 70% balance?

dialogue.zh: 对，定金付了我们就安排生产，尾款发货前付清。
dialogue.py: Duì, dìngjīn fù le wǒmen jiù ānpái shēngchǎn, wěikuǎn fāhuò qián fùqīng.
dialogue.ru: Yes, after the deposit we start production, and the balance is due before shipment.

dialogue.zh: 尾款能不能见提单副本再付？这样我们更放心。
dialogue.py: Wěikuǎn néng bu néng jiàn tídān fùběn zài fù? Zhèyàng wǒmen gèng fàngxīn.
dialogue.ru: Can the balance be paid against a copy of the bill of lading? That would put us more at ease.

dialogue.zh: 老客户可以，第一次合作的话，我们需要发货前收齐。
dialogue.py: Lǎo kèhù kěyǐ, dì-yī cì hézuò dehuà, wǒmen xūyào fāhuò qián shōuqí.
dialogue.ru: For regular customers yes, but for a first order we need full payment before shipment.

dialogue.zh: 那出货前我们安排验货，验货通过再付尾款，可以吗？
dialogue.py: Nà chūhuò qián wǒmen ānpái yànhuò, yànhuò tōngguò zài fù wěikuǎn, kěyǐ ma?
dialogue.ru: Then before shipment we'll conduct an inspection and pay the balance after it. Does that work?

dialogue.zh: 可以。您打算怎么付款？
dialogue.py: Kěyǐ. Nín dǎsuàn zěnme fùkuǎn?
dialogue.ru: That works. How do you plan to pay?

dialogue.zh: 用人民币，通过支付代理汇款，付款方的名字会不一样。
dialogue.py: Yòng Rénmínbì, tōngguò zhīfù dàilǐ huìkuǎn, fùkuǎnfāng de míngzi huì bù yíyàng.
dialogue.ru: In yuan, through a payment agent, the payer's name will be different.

dialogue.zh: 没问题，但请提前把付款方的信息发给我，我跟银行报备一下，不然可能会被退回。
dialogue.py: Méi wèntí, dàn qǐng tíqián bǎ fùkuǎnfāng de xìnxī fā gěi wǒ, wǒ gēn yínháng bàobèi yíxià, bùrán kěnéng huì bèi tuìhuí.
dialogue.ru: Okay, but send the payer's details in advance, I'll warn the bank, otherwise the payment may be returned.

topics.culture: A common practice is a 30% deposit and 70% before shipment (T/T 30/70), but it's an agreement between the parties, not a rule. For a first order factories rarely agree to payment of the balance against a copy of the bill of lading, but often accept payment of the balance after an inspection. Russian importers usually pay in yuan through banks that work with China, and sometimes through payment agents; payments can be delayed or returned, so agree with the supplier in advance on who will be the payer, and check the payment purpose against the contract. Pay only to the corporate account of the company named in the contract, and confirm any “change of bank details” by voice or video with a manager you know. Check the specific payment scheme and currency control requirements (for example, whether the contract needs to be registered with the bank) with your bank and a lawyer.

quiz.q: What does 尾款 mean?
quiz.explain: 定金 means deposit, 尾款 means balance.

quiz.q: A supplier writes in an email: “we have new bank details.” What do you do?
options: Pay right away so as not to delay production
Ask them to send the details again in the same email
Confirm by voice or video with a manager you know before paying
quiz.explain: Substituting bank details in correspondence is a common scam.

quiz.q: What is 水单?
options: A bank confirmation of a transfer
A receipt for payment of a duty
quiz.explain: It is sent to the supplier so they can find the payment.

quiz.q: You're paying through a payment agent. What is important to do?
options: Nothing, the supplier's bank doesn't care
Tell the supplier the payer's details in advance
Send the payment with no purpose stated
quiz.explain: Without a warning, the recipient's bank may return a payment from an unfamiliar party.

role.ai_role: the finance manager (财务) of a furniture factory in Foshan: cautious, demands a 50% deposit from a new client and 100% before shipment, worries about payments returned from Russia, but accepts reasonable guarantees
role.user_goal: agree on a 30% deposit and the balance after inspection (or against a copy of the bill of lading), agree on payment through a payment agent in yuan, and check the bank details and the procedure for confirming any changes to them
role.opening: 您好，我是财务小陈。新客户我们一般要百分之五十定金，尾款发货前付清。另外，最近从俄罗斯过来的款经常被退，您打算怎么付？
checklist: Asked to lower the deposit to 30% and gave reasons
Proposed protection for yourself: the balance after inspection or against a copy of the bill of lading
Said that the payment will go through an agent in yuan and offered to send the payer's details in advance
Clarified the bank details (corporate account, bank, SWIFT) and who pays the fees
Agreed to confirm any change of bank details by voice or video

topics.title: Production, Quality Control, and Defects
topics.intro: After the deposit, the most important part begins: deadlines and quality. We'll learn to agree on timing, reports, and a pre-shipment inspection, and if defective goods still arrive, to make a claim calmly and with evidence.

phrases.ru: Can you guarantee the delivery date?
phrases.note: 交期 means the readiness/shipping deadline.

phrases.ru: Will you be able to ship before Chinese New Year?

phrases.zh: 请每周给我们发一次生产进度和照片。
phrases.py: Qǐng měi zhōu gěi wǒmen fā yí cì shēngchǎn jìndù hé zhàopiàn.
phrases.ru: Please send us a production status update and photos once a week.

phrases.zh: 我们会安排第三方验货。
phrases.py: Wǒmen huì ānpái dì-sān fāng yànhuò.
phrases.ru: We will arrange a third-party inspection.

phrases.py: Yànhuò àn AQL èr diǎn wǔ biāozhǔn.
phrases.ru: The inspection will follow the AQL 2.5 standard.
phrases.note: AQL 2.5 is a common level for major defects.

phrases.zh: 出货前请等验货报告通过再装柜。
phrases.py: Chūhuò qián qǐng děng yànhuò bàogào tōngguò zài zhuāngguì.
phrases.ru: Before shipment, wait for a passing inspection report and only then load the container.

phrases.py: Zhè pī huò gēn yàngpǐn bù yízhì.
phrases.ru: This batch doesn't match the sample.

phrases.zh: 次品率太高了，超过了百分之五。
phrases.py: Cìpǐnlǜ tài gāo le, chāoguò le bǎi fēn zhī wǔ.
phrases.ru: The defect rate is too high, over 5%.

phrases.zh: 我们发了照片和视频，请你们看一下。
phrases.py: Wǒmen fā le zhàopiàn hé shìpín, qǐng nǐmen kàn yíxià.
phrases.ru: We've sent photos and videos, please take a look.
How do you plan to resolve this?

phrases.zh: 次品请你们补发，费用由你们承担。
phrases.py: Cìpǐn qǐng nǐmen bǔfā, fèiyòng yóu nǐmen chéngdān.
phrases.ru: Please resend the defective items, at your expense.

phrases.zh: 或者从下一单的货款里扣。
phrases.py: Huòzhě cóng xià yí dān de huòkuǎn lǐ kòu.
phrases.ru: Or deduct it from the payment for the next order.
phrases.note: A common form of compensation in practice.

phrases.zh: 延期交货的话，要按合同扣款。
phrases.py: Yánqī jiāohuò dehuà, yào àn hétong kòukuǎn.
phrases.ru: If delivery is late, a deduction applies according to the contract.

phrases.zh: 请找出原因，下次不要再出现。
phrases.py: Qǐng zhǎochū yuányīn, xià cì búyào zài chūxiàn.
phrases.ru: Please find the cause so that this doesn't happen again.

dialogue.zh: 张经理，货到了，我们检查发现很多问题。
dialogue.py: Zhāng jīnglǐ, huò dào le, wǒmen jiǎnchá fāxiàn hěn duō wèntí.
dialogue.ru: Manager Zhang, the goods have arrived, and we found many problems during inspection.

dialogue.zh: 什么问题？您具体说一下。
dialogue.py: Shénme wèntí? Nín jùtǐ shuō yíxià.
dialogue.ru: What problems? Tell me in more detail.

dialogue.zh: 两千个里面有一百六十个开关不灵，次品率百分之八，远远超过了约定的标准。
dialogue.py: Liǎngqiān ge lǐmiàn yǒu yìbǎi liùshí ge kāiguān bù líng, cìpǐnlǜ bǎi fēn zhī bā, yuǎnyuǎn chāoguò le yuēdìng de biāozhǔn.
dialogue.ru: Out of 2,000 pieces, 160 have a switch that doesn't work: 8% defective, much higher than agreed.

dialogue.zh: 出货前我们都检查过的，会不会是运输的时候坏的？
dialogue.py: Chūhuò qián wǒmen dōu jiǎnchá guo de, huì bu huì shì yùnshū de shíhou huài de?
dialogue.ru: We checked everything before shipment. Maybe they were damaged in transit?

dialogue.zh: 不是，外箱完好无损。照片和视频都发给您了，跟封样也不一致。
dialogue.py: Bú shì, wàixiāng wánhǎo-wúsǔn. Zhàopiàn hé shìpín dōu fā gěi nín le, gēn fēngyàng yě bù yízhì.
dialogue.ru: No, the cartons are intact. I sent photos and video, and it doesn't match the reference sample.

dialogue.zh: 好的，我让质检部门看一下……确实是我们的问题，那批开关配件有问题。
dialogue.py: Hǎo de, wǒ ràng zhìjiǎn bùmén kàn yíxià…… Quèshí shì wǒmen de wèntí, nà pī kāiguān pèijiàn yǒu wèntí.
dialogue.ru: Okay, I'll pass it to QC… Yes, it was our mistake, the batch of switches was defective.

dialogue.zh: 你们打算怎么处理？
dialogue.py: Nǐmen dǎsuàn zěnme chǔlǐ?
dialogue.ru: How will you resolve it?

dialogue.zh: 我们可以在下一单补发一百六十个，或者从下一单的货款里扣。
dialogue.py: Wǒmen kěyǐ zài xià yí dān bǔfā yìbǎi liùshí ge, huòzhě cóng xià yí dān de huòkuǎn lǐ kòu.
dialogue.ru: We can resend 160 pieces with the next order or deduct it from the payment for the next order.

dialogue.zh: 从货款里扣吧，另外请出一份整改报告。
dialogue.py: Cóng huòkuǎn lǐ kòu ba, lìngwài qǐng chū yí fèn zhěnggǎi bàogào.
dialogue.ru: Let's deduct it from the payment. And please send a corrective action report.

topics.culture: Production time is often 25–45 days after the deposit and sample approval (depending on the product), and around Chinese New Year (in 2027, February 6) many factories shut down for several weeks, so orders for spring are placed before the beginning of December. A third-party pre-shipment inspection usually costs a few hundred dollars per person-day and is cheaper than any claim. Record defects immediately: photos and video of the unpacking, intact cartons, comparison with the reference sample, and a count of the percentage. Defective goods are rarely refunded in cash: usually it's a credit on the next order or a resend. A calm tone and facts work better than pressure: it's easier for the supplier to admit a mistake without losing face.

quiz.q: What does 交期 mean?
quiz.explain: 交期 = 交货期, the deadline for handing over the goods.

quiz.q: What is AQL 2.5?
options: The level of acceptable defects in a sampling inspection
quiz.explain: AQL (acceptance quality limit) under ISO 2859-1 is the limit on the acceptable share of defects in a sampling inspection of a batch.

quiz.q: How does a factory most often compensate for defects?
options: A refund on the same day
A credit on the next order or a resend
Not at all, defects are the buyer's risk
quiz.explain: This is the most common practical option.

quiz.q: When should you place an order to ship it before Chinese New Year 2027 (February 6)?
options: On the day of the holiday
quiz.explain: Allowing for 25–45 days of production and the pre-holiday workload.

role.ai_role: a sales manager at an electric kettle factory in Cixi (Zhejiang): first denies fault (“damaged on the way”), offers token compensation, but admits the problem if the buyer brings specific evidence
