role.user_goal: document the 8% defect rate (160 of 2,000 kettles with a faulty switch), get fair compensation (a credit or a resend) and a corrective plan, while preserving the relationship
role.opening: 您好，听说货到了？我们出货前都是一个一个检查的，应该没有问题吧？
checklist: Clearly described the defect and gave figures (160 of 2,000, 8%)
Provided evidence: photos/video, intact cartons, comparison with the reference sample
Calmly rejected the version about damage in transit
Secured specific compensation: a credit or a resend at the factory's expense
Asked them to find the cause and send a corrective action report

topics.title: Logistics and Documents
topics.intro: The goods are ready; now they need to be delivered to Russia legally and without surprises. We'll learn to discuss delivery terms (FOB, EXW, FCA and their Chinese names), the route, the invoice, the packing list, and carton markings.

phrases.py: Nǐmen bào de shì FOB jià háishi EXW jià?
phrases.ru: Is your price FOB or EXW?
phrases.note: In the official Chinese translation of Incoterms, FOB is 船上交货 (colloquially 离岸价), EXW is 工厂交货 (colloquially 出厂价), CIF is 成本、保险费加运费 (colloquially 到岸价).

phrases.py: Qǐng bào FOB Níngbō de jiàgé.
phrases.ru: Please quote the price FOB Ningbo.

phrases.zh: 我们的货代会联系你们。
phrases.py: Wǒmen de huòdài huì liánxì nǐmen.
phrases.ru: Our freight forwarder will contact you.
phrases.note: 货代 means freight forwarder.

phrases.zh: 这批货走海运还是铁路？
phrases.py: Zhè pī huò zǒu hǎiyùn háishi tiělù?
phrases.ru: Is this shipment going by sea or by rail?
A full container or consolidated cargo?
phrases.note: 整柜 — FCL, 拼箱 — LCL.

phrases.ru: When can the container be loaded?

phrases.zh: 请把货送到我们货代在义乌的仓库。
phrases.py: Qǐng bǎ huò sòng dào wǒmen huòdài zài Yìwū de cāngkù.
phrases.ru: Please deliver the goods to our forwarder's warehouse in Yiwu.

phrases.zh: 请提供商业发票和装箱单。
phrases.py: Qǐng tígōng shāngyè fāpiào hé zhuāngxiāngdān.
phrases.ru: Please provide a commercial invoice and a packing list.

phrases.zh: 发票上的品名和HS编码要准确。
phrases.py: Fāpiào shàng de pǐnmíng hé HS biānmǎ yào zhǔnquè.
phrases.ru: The product name and the HS code on the invoice must be accurate.

phrases.zh: 装箱单上要写清楚每箱的毛重、净重和体积。
phrases.py: Zhuāngxiāngdān shàng yào xiě qīngchu měi xiāng de máozhòng, jìngzhòng hé tǐjī.
phrases.ru: In the packing list, state the gross weight, net weight, and volume of each carton.

phrases.zh: 发票金额要和实际付款一致。
phrases.py: Fāpiào jīn'é yào hé shíjì fùkuǎn yízhì.
phrases.ru: The invoice amount must match the actual payment.
phrases.note: Understating the value in Russia is false customs declaration (Art. 16.2 of the Russian Code of Administrative Offenses): additional charges, a fine, and possible confiscation of the goods.

phrases.py: Nǐmen néng zuò chūkǒu bàoguān ma?
phrases.ru: Can you handle the export customs declaration?

phrases.py: Xiāngzi shàng yào tiē Éwén màitóu.
phrases.ru: Markings in Russian must be stuck on the cartons.
phrases.note: 唛头 means shipping mark, the marking of cargo packages.

phrases.ru: When will the bill of lading be issued?

dialogue.zh: 刘经理，大货下周能好吗？
dialogue.py: Liú jīnglǐ, dàhuò xià zhōu néng hǎo ma?
dialogue.ru: Manager Liu, will the batch be ready next week?

dialogue.zh: 下周三就能全部完成。您这次走海运还是铁路？
dialogue.py: Xià zhōusān jiù néng quánbù wánchéng. Nín zhè cì zǒu hǎiyùn háishi tiělù?
dialogue.ru: Everything will be ready by next Wednesday. This time by sea or by rail?

dialogue.zh: 走铁路，到莫斯科。我们的货代会联系你们安排提货。
dialogue.py: Zǒu tiělù, dào Mòsīkē. Wǒmen de huòdài huì liánxì nǐmen ānpái tíhuò.
dialogue.ru: By rail to Moscow. Our forwarder will contact you and arrange the pickup of the cargo.

dialogue.zh: 好的。我们报的是EXW价，从工厂提货，运费和出口报关都是你们货代负责，对吧？
dialogue.py: Hǎo de. Wǒmen bào de shì EXW jià, cóng gōngchǎng tíhuò, yùnfèi hé chūkǒu bàoguān dōu shì nǐmen huòdài fùzé, duì ba?
dialogue.ru: Okay. Our price is EXW, pickup from the factory, and transport and export clearance are on your forwarder, right?

dialogue.zh: 对。不过请提供商业发票和装箱单，品名和HS编码一定要准确。
dialogue.py: Duì. Búguò qǐng tígōng shāngyè fāpiào hé zhuāngxiāngdān, pǐnmíng hé HS biānmǎ yídìng yào zhǔnquè.
dialogue.ru: Yes. But please provide the invoice and packing list, the name and HS code must be accurate.

dialogue.zh: 没问题。装箱单上每箱的毛重、净重和体积都会写清楚。
dialogue.py: Méi wèntí. Zhuāngxiāngdān shàng měi xiāng de máozhòng, jìngzhòng hé tǐjī dōu huì xiě qīngchu.
dialogue.ru: No problem. The packing list will have the gross weight, net weight, and volume of each carton.

dialogue.zh: 还有，箱子上要贴俄文唛头，我把模板发给您。
dialogue.py: Háiyǒu, xiāngzi shàng yào tiē Éwén màitóu, wǒ bǎ múbǎn fā gěi nín.
dialogue.ru: And one more thing: the cartons need markings in Russian, I'll send a template.

dialogue.zh: 好的，收到模板后我们安排打印，装箱前拍照给您确认。
dialogue.py: Hǎo de, shōudào múbǎn hòu wǒmen ānpái dǎyìn, zhuāngxiāng qián pāizhào gěi nín quèrèn.
dialogue.ru: Okay, once we get the template we'll print it out and send you a photo for confirmation before packing.

topics.culture: Delivery terms are discussed under Incoterms 2020: with EXW (工厂交货) the buyer picks up the goods at the factory (the seller isn't even obliged to load them) and is responsible for export clearance in China; with FOB (船上交货, colloquially 离岸价) the supplier handles export and loads the goods on the ship at the named port, and from that moment the risk passes to the buyer; with CIF (colloquially 到岸价) the seller also pays the freight and minimum insurance to the port of destination, but the risk likewise passes to the buyer at loading in China. FOB and CIF are for sea transport only; for rail, road, and containerized multimodal transport the ICC recommends FCA (货交承运人). Cargo goes to Russia by sea (to Vladivostok or St. Petersburg), by rail (to Moscow, usually several weeks including transshipment), or by road through border crossings. Official (“white”) import requires a contract, an invoice, a packing list, EAEU conformity documents (if the product falls under technical regulations), payment of customs duties and VAT, and for a number of goods, “Chestny Znak” marking; “turnkey cargo” is cheaper but doesn't give you documents for the goods. Don't agree to understate the value on the invoice: the amount must match the payment, otherwise additional charges and fines are possible. Check the specific requirements for your product with a customs broker.

quiz.q: What is the FOB term called in Chinese?
quiz.explain: 离岸价 — FOB; 到岸价 — CIF; 出厂价/工厂交货 — EXW.

quiz.q: What is 装箱单?
quiz.explain: A bill of lading is 提单, a proforma is 形式发票 (PI).

quiz.q: Under EXW terms, who usually handles export clearance in China?
quiz.explain: Under EXW the seller merely makes the goods available at their own premises; export clearance and loading are the buyer's concern.

quiz.q: What is 唛头?
options: The marking on a shipping carton (shipping mark)
quiz.explain: It usually shows the consignee, carton number, weight, and country.

role.ai_role: a manager at an umbrella factory in Shangyu (Shaoxing): wants to switch from FOB to EXW so as not to deal with export, gets confused with documents, and in passing suggests understating the value on the invoice “as many clients do”
role.user_goal: keep the FOB Ningbo term (or consciously agree on EXW with a clear division of duties), get a correct invoice and packing list (HS code, weight, volume), politely decline to understate the value, and agree on marking the cartons in Russian
role.opening: 安德烈您好！货下周就好了。我们想改成EXW，您的货代直接来工厂提货，这样简单一点。另外发票金额要不要写低一点？很多客户都这么做。
checklist: Discussed FOB vs EXW and who is responsible for export clearance
Requested a commercial invoice and packing list with the HS code, gross/net weight, and volume
Refused to understate the value: invoice amount = actual payment
Agreed on marking the cartons (唛头) in Russian and on photos before shipment
Clarified the loading date and the issue of the bill of lading/transport document

topics.title: The Canton Fair and Business Cards
topics.intro: The Canton Fair in Guangzhou is a place where you can find dozens of suppliers in a few days. We'll learn to introduce yourself quickly at a booth, ask the main questions, exchange business cards and WeChat, and arrange a factory visit.

phrases.zh: 你好，可以看一下你们的产品吗？
phrases.py: Nǐ hǎo, kěyǐ kàn yíxià nǐmen de chǎnpǐn ma?
phrases.ru: Hello, may I take a look at your products?

phrases.py: Zhè shì jīnnián de xīnkuǎn ma?
Wǒmen duì zhè jǐ kuǎn gǎn xìngqù.

phrases.zh: 这个展品的价格是多少？
phrases.py: Zhège zhǎnpǐn de jiàgé shì duōshao?
phrases.ru: What is the price of this display item?

phrases.note: Some exhibitors don't allow photos: always ask.

phrases.zh: 我们加个微信吧，我扫你还是你扫我？
phrases.py: Wǒmen jiā ge Wēixìn ba, wǒ sǎo nǐ háishi nǐ sǎo wǒ?
phrases.ru: Let's add each other on WeChat. Do I scan you or do you scan me?

phrases.zh: 有英文或者俄文的目录吗？
phrases.py: Yǒu Yīngwén huòzhě Éwén de mùlù ma?
phrases.ru: Do you have a catalog in English or Russian?

phrases.zh: 请把报价发到我的微信。
phrases.py: Qǐng bǎ bàojià fā dào wǒ de Wēixìn.
phrases.ru: Please send the quote to my WeChat.

phrases.zh: 你们是工厂吗？工厂在哪里？
phrases.py: Nǐmen shì gōngchǎng ma? Gōngchǎng zài nǎlǐ?
phrases.ru: Are you a factory? Where is production?

phrases.zh: 你们的工厂离广州远吗？
phrases.py: Nǐmen de gōngchǎng lí Guǎngzhōu yuǎn ma?
phrases.ru: Is your factory far from Guangzhou?

phrases.zh: 我们展会后去你们工厂看看。
phrases.py: Wǒmen zhǎnhuì hòu qù nǐmen gōngchǎng kànkan.
phrases.ru: After the fair we'll go see your factory.

phrases.zh: 请问家居用品在哪个馆？
phrases.py: Qǐngwèn jiājū yòngpǐn zài nǎge guǎn?
phrases.ru: Could you tell me which hall has household goods?

phrases.zh: 我们明天再来，到时候详细谈。
phrases.py: Wǒmen míngtiān zài lái, dào shíhou xiángxì tán.
phrases.ru: We'll come back tomorrow and discuss it in detail then.

dialogue.zh: 你好，可以看一下你们的产品吗？
dialogue.py: Nǐ hǎo, kěyǐ kàn yíxià nǐmen de chǎnpǐn ma?
dialogue.ru: Hello, may I take a look at your products?

dialogue.zh: 欢迎！请进来看，这些都是今年的新款。
dialogue.py: Huānyíng! Qǐng jìnlai kàn, zhèxiē dōu shì jīnnián de xīnkuǎn.
dialogue.ru: Welcome! Come in, these are all new this year.

dialogue.zh: 这款厨房收纳架是什么材质的？
dialogue.py: Zhè kuǎn chúfáng shōunàjià shì shénme cáizhì de?
dialogue.ru: What is this kitchen shelf made of?

dialogue.zh: 碳钢喷涂的，承重二十公斤。您是哪个国家的客户？
dialogue.py: Tàngāng pēntú de, chéngzhòng èrshí gōngjīn. Nín shì nǎge guójiā de kèhù?
dialogue.ru: Coated carbon steel, it holds 20 kg. Which country are you from?

dialogue.zh: 俄罗斯的，我们做家居用品批发。可以交换一下名片吗？
dialogue.py: Éluósī de, wǒmen zuò jiājū yòngpǐn pīfā. Kěyǐ jiāohuàn yíxià míngpiàn ma?
dialogue.ru: From Russia, we're wholesalers of household goods. Shall we exchange business cards?

dialogue.zh: 当然，这是我的名片。我们加个微信吧，我扫您。
dialogue.py: Dāngrán, zhè shì wǒ de míngpiàn. Wǒmen jiā ge Wēixìn ba, wǒ sǎo nín.
dialogue.ru: Of course, here's my card. Let's add each other on WeChat, I'll scan your code.

dialogue.zh: 好。展会后我们想去你们工厂看看，方便吗？
dialogue.py: Hǎo. Zhǎnhuì hòu wǒmen xiǎng qù nǐmen gōngchǎng kànkan, fāngbiàn ma?
dialogue.ru: Okay. After the fair we'd like to visit your factory, is that possible?

dialogue.zh: 非常欢迎！我们工厂在佛山，从广州开车一个小时左右，我们可以安排车来接您。
dialogue.py: Fēicháng huānyíng! Wǒmen gōngchǎng zài Fóshān, cóng Guǎngzhōu kāichē yí ge xiǎoshí zuǒyòu, wǒmen kěyǐ ānpái chē lái jiē nín.
dialogue.ru: We'd be delighted! The factory is in Foshan, about an hour by car from Guangzhou, and we can send a car for you.

topics.culture: The Canton Fair (中国进出口商品交易会, 广交会 for short) takes place in Guangzhou twice a year, in spring (April–May) and autumn (October–November), in three phases for different product categories. The 139th session (spring 2026): April 15–19, April 23–27, and May 1–5; the 140th (autumn 2026): October 15–19, October 23–27, and October 31 – November 4; household and kitchen goods are in the second phase. Check your phase in advance at cantonfair.org.cn and complete online pre-registration as a foreign buyer, and you'll receive your badge at a pickup point (for example, at Baiyun Airport or Guangzhou South Railway Station). A business card is given and received with both hands, read, and put away carefully, not straight into a back pocket; in 2026 WeChat is almost always scanned along with the card. At the booths many are trading companies, so the question “where is your factory?” and a visit to production after the fair are a must. During the fair, hotels in Guangzhou get noticeably more expensive, so book ahead.

quiz.q: What is the Canton Fair called in Chinese for short?
quiz.explain: 广交会 is short for 中国进出口商品交易会 (广州).

quiz.q: How do you correctly accept a business card?
options: With one hand and straight into your pocket
With both hands, read it, and put it away carefully
quiz.explain: This is a sign of respect for the person and their company.

quiz.q: What does 展位号 mean?
quiz.explain: 展位 means booth; a hall is 展馆 or 馆.

quiz.q: When does the Canton Fair take place?
options: Twice a year: in spring and autumn, in three phases
quiz.explain: The spring session is April–May, the autumn session October–November (the 140th: October 15 – November 4, 2026).

role.ai_role: a booth manager of a Foshan manufacturer of kitchen accessories at the Canton Fair: very busy, there's a line at the booth, she first answers perfunctorily and quotes a higher-than-usual price
role.user_goal: interest the manager within a few minutes (briefly introduce your company and volumes), find out the price and material of a couple of models, work out whether it is a factory, exchange business cards/WeChat, and arrange a factory visit after the fair
role.opening: 您好，随便看看！这些都是新款。不好意思，今天人比较多，您对哪一款感兴趣？
checklist: Briefly introduced your company, country, and volumes
Asked about the material and price of specific models
Found out whether it is a factory and where production is
Exchanged business cards and WeChat
Arranged a factory visit or the next contact

topics.title: Business Dinner, Gifts, and 关系
topics.intro: In China, long-term relationships (关系) are built at the table no less than in the meeting room. We'll learn to give toasts, politely decline extra alcohol, give gifts, and gently return to business.

phrases.ru: Thank you for your warm hospitality.
Mr. Wang, you are too kind.

phrases.zh: 我敬您一杯，祝我们合作愉快！
phrases.py: Wǒ jìng nín yì bēi, zhù wǒmen hézuò yúkuài!
phrases.ru: I raise a glass to you: to our successful cooperation!
Drink as much as you like.
phrases.note: Means that you don't have to drain the glass.

phrases.zh: 我不太能喝酒，以茶代酒，敬您。
phrases.py: Wǒ bú tài néng hē jiǔ, yǐ chá dài jiǔ, jìng nín.
phrases.ru: I don't hold my alcohol well, allow me to raise tea instead of wine: to you.
phrases.note: An acceptable way to decline without offending the host.

phrases.ru: As a sign of respect, I'll drain mine first.

phrases.py: Zhè dào cài shì shénme? Hěn hǎochī.
phrases.ru: What is this dish? It's very tasty.

phrases.zh: 这是我们从俄罗斯带来的一点心意，请收下。
phrases.py: Zhè shì wǒmen cóng Éluósī dàilái de yìdiǎn xīnyì, qǐng shōuxià.
phrases.ru: This is a small token of attention from Russia, please accept it.
A modest gift, just a small token of respect.
phrases.note: A traditional modest formula when presenting a gift.

phrases.zh: 合作这么多年，我们是老朋友了。
phrases.py: Hézuò zhème duō nián, wǒmen shì lǎo péngyou le.
phrases.ru: We've cooperated for so many years, we're old friends now.

phrases.zh: 下次您来莫斯科，一定由我来安排。
phrases.py: Xià cì nín lái Mòsīkē, yídìng yóu wǒ lái ānpái.
phrases.ru: Next time you come to Moscow, I'll arrange everything.

phrases.py: Zhè cì wǒ lái mǎidān ba.

phrases.zh: 今天不谈生意，明天我们在办公室再细聊。
phrases.py: Jīntiān bù tán shēngyi, míngtiān wǒmen zài bàngōngshì zài xì liáo.
phrases.ru: Today we won't talk business, tomorrow we'll discuss it in detail at the office.
phrases.note: Politely moves a serious matter to a business meeting.

phrases.zh: 春节快乐，祝您生意兴隆！
phrases.py: Chūnjié kuàilè, zhù nín shēngyi xīnglóng!
phrases.ru: Happy Chinese New Year, and may your business prosper!

dialogue.zh: 安德烈，欢迎来佛山！今天我们点了几道地道的广东菜，您尝尝。
dialogue.py: Āndéliè, huānyíng lái Fóshān! Jīntiān wǒmen diǎn le jǐ dào dìdao de Guǎngdōng cài, nín chángchang.
dialogue.ru: Andrei, welcome to Foshan! We've ordered some authentic Cantonese dishes, please try them.

dialogue.zh: 王总太客气了，感谢您的盛情款待。
dialogue.py: Wáng zǒng tài kèqi le, gǎnxiè nín de shèngqíng kuǎndài.
dialogue.ru: Ms. Wang, you are too kind, thank you for your warm hospitality.

dialogue.zh: 来，我敬您一杯，祝我们合作愉快！
dialogue.py: Lái, wǒ jìng nín yì bēi, zhù wǒmen hézuò yúkuài!
dialogue.ru: Let's drink to you: to our successful cooperation!

dialogue.zh: 谢谢王总！我不太能喝白酒，以茶代酒，敬您。
dialogue.py: Xièxie Wáng zǒng! Wǒ bú tài néng hē báijiǔ, yǐ chá dài jiǔ, jìng nín.
dialogue.ru: Thank you! I don't hold baijiu well, allow me to raise tea instead of wine: to you.

dialogue.zh: 没关系，随意随意。
dialogue.py: Méi guānxi, suíyì suíyì.
dialogue.ru: No problem, drink however suits you.

dialogue.zh: 这是我们从俄罗斯带来的一点心意，请收下。
dialogue.py: Zhè shì wǒmen cóng Éluósī dàilái de yìdiǎn xīnyì, qǐng shōuxià.
dialogue.ru: This is a small token of attention from Russia, please accept it.

dialogue.zh: 哎呀，太客气了！这是什么？
dialogue.py: Āiyā, tài kèqi le! Zhè shì shénme?
dialogue.ru: Oh, you shouldn't have! What is this?

dialogue.zh: 是西伯利亚的松子，还有一盒俄罗斯巧克力，给您和家人尝尝。
dialogue.py: Shì Xībólìyà de sōngzǐ, háiyǒu yì hé Éluósī qiǎokèlì, gěi nín hé jiārén chángchang.
dialogue.ru: Siberian cedar nuts and a box of Russian chocolate, for you and your family.

dialogue.zh: 谢谢！下次您来，我们带您去祖庙转转。
dialogue.py: Xièxie! Xià cì nín lái, wǒmen dài nín qù Zǔmiào zhuànzhuan.
dialogue.ru: Thank you! Next time we'll show you the Zumiao Temple.

topics.culture: Dinner is usually organized and paid for by the inviting side; the guest of honor is seated to the right of the host, and the host sits facing the entrance. Toasts go by seniority, and when clinking, the rim of your glass is slightly lower than the senior person's; you can decline baijiu with 以茶代酒 or by citing your health, which isn't offensive. Good gifts are souvenirs and food from Russia (chocolate, honey, cedar nuts); don't give clocks (送钟 sounds like “to see off on the final journey”), umbrellas, sharp objects, or money, and a gift may first be politely declined. Serious business questions at the table are best gently moved to a meeting at the office, and relationships maintained with WeChat greetings at Chinese New Year and the Mid-Autumn Festival.

quiz.q: Which gift should you NOT give?
quiz.explain: 送钟 (giving a clock) sounds like 送终 — "seeing someone off on their final journey."

quiz.q: You don't drink alcohol. How can you politely respond to a toast?
quiz.explain: 以茶代酒 — "tea instead of wine," the standard polite phrase.

quiz.q: What does "随意" mean in a toast?
options: Drink as much as you like, no need to finish the glass
quiz.explain: Unlike 干杯, 随意 removes the obligation to drain your glass.

quiz.q: Who usually pays for a business dinner in China?
options: The most junior person by rank
quiz.explain: The host treats everyone; in return, the guest invites them next time.

role.ai_role: 王总 — a factory owner and long-time supplier, at a dinner in Foshan: very warm and welcoming, keeps pressing baijiu on you, and in the middle of the feast casually mentions a price increase of 8% starting next quarter
role.user_goal: handle the dinner with dignity (a toast, a polite way to turn down extra alcohol, presenting a gift) and, without spoiling the mood, not agree to the price increase at the table: move the discussion to a meeting at the office or get the current price kept for the next order
role.opening: 安德烈，欢迎欢迎！来，先坐。今天咱们不谈生意，只喝酒！这是我珍藏了十年的茅台，必须尝尝！
checklist: Thanked the host for the hospitality and gave a toast in return
Politely limited the alcohol (以茶代酒, 随意, or a reference to health) without making the host lose face
Presented a gift with an appropriate modest phrase
Did not agree to the price increase at the table: moved it to a business meeting or asked to keep the price for the current order
Stressed the value of a long-term relationship and invited them to visit in return

tracks.title: For yourself: culture and hobbies
tracks.ru: Chinese for fun: hobbies, food, holidays, travel, movies, tea, superstitions and internet slang — so you can chat with Chinese people about life and understand their culture.

topics.title: Getting to know people and talking about hobbies
topics.intro: The first topic for any language exchange, trip, or chat with a Chinese friend. You'll learn to introduce yourself, talk about what you enjoy, ask the other person questions, and swap WeChat — that's exactly how friendships start in China.

phrases.zh: 你好，我叫安娜，是俄罗斯人。
phrases.py: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ jiào Ānnà, shì Éluósī rén.
phrases.ru: Hi, my name is Anna, and I'm from Russia.

phrases.py: Wǒ xǐhuan kàn shū hé lǚxíng.

phrases.ru: What do you usually do on weekends?
phrases.note: The most natural way to ask about hobbies without sounding like a questionnaire.

phrases.zh: 我对中国书法很感兴趣。
phrases.py: Wǒ duì Zhōngguó shūfǎ hěn gǎn xìngqù.
phrases.ru: I'm very interested in Chinese calligraphy.
phrases.note: The pattern 对……感兴趣 means "to be interested in something."

phrases.zh: 我在学中文，学了一年了。
phrases.py: Wǒ zài xué Zhōngwén, xué le yì nián le.
phrases.ru: I'm studying Chinese. I've been at it for a year.
On ordinary days, I like cooking.

phrases.note: 弹 — to play string and keyboard instruments (弹钢琴 — to play the piano).
A playful way to describe yourself. Chinese people love this phrase — it breaks the ice right away.

phrases.py: Yǒu kòng yìqǐ qù pá shān ba!
phrases.ru: When you have time, let's go hiking in the mountains together!
Let's add each other on WeChat.
phrases.note: In China, people hardly ever swap phone numbers — they add each other on WeChat right away.

phrases.py: Nǐ sǎo wǒ háishi wǒ sǎo nǐ?
phrases.ru: Do you scan my QR code, or do I scan yours?
phrases.note: The classic question when adding someone on WeChat.

phrases.zh: 我的中文不太好，请说慢一点。
phrases.py: Wǒ de Zhōngwén bú tài hǎo, qǐng shuō màn yìdiǎn.
phrases.ru: My Chinese isn't very good, so please speak a little more slowly.

dialogue.zh: 你好！你是新来的吧？我叫李静。
dialogue.py: Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ shì xīn lái de ba? Wǒ jiào Lǐ Jìng.
dialogue.ru: Hi! Are you new here? My name is Li Jing.

dialogue.zh: 你好，我叫伊万，是俄罗斯人。很高兴认识你！
dialogue.py: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ jiào Yīwàn, shì Éluósī rén. Hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ!
dialogue.ru: Hi, I'm Ivan, from Russia. Nice to meet you!

dialogue.zh: 你的中文说得真不错！学了多久了？
dialogue.py: Nǐ de Zhōngwén shuō de zhēn búcuò! Xué le duō jiǔ le?
dialogue.ru: Your Chinese is great! Have you been studying long?

dialogue.zh: 哪里哪里，学了一年多了。我对中国文化很感兴趣。
dialogue.py: Nǎli nǎli, xué le yì nián duō le. Wǒ duì Zhōngguó wénhuà hěn gǎn xìngqù.
dialogue.ru: Oh, not at all, just over a year. I'm really interested in Chinese culture.

dialogue.zh: 那你平时有什么爱好？
dialogue.py: Nà nǐ píngshí yǒu shénme àihào?
dialogue.ru: And what are your hobbies?

dialogue.zh: 我喜欢爬山和做饭，最近在学包饺子。
dialogue.py: Wǒ xǐhuan pá shān hé zuò fàn, zuìjìn zài xué bāo jiǎozi.
dialogue.ru: I like hiking and cooking, and lately I've been learning to make jiaozi.

dialogue.zh: 太好了！我也喜欢爬山。周末要不要一起去？
dialogue.py: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ yě xǐhuan pá shān. Zhōumò yào bu yào yìqǐ qù?
dialogue.ru: Nice! I like the mountains too. Shall we go together this weekend?

dialogue.zh: 好啊！我们加个微信吧，我扫你。
dialogue.py: Hǎo a! Wǒmen jiā ge Wēixìn ba, wǒ sǎo nǐ.
dialogue.ru: Sure! Let's add each other on WeChat — I'll scan your code.

topics.culture: When someone compliments you with "你的中文真好！", Chinese people expect modesty: "哪里哪里" or "还差得远呢" (I still have a long way to go) sound far more natural than "谢谢". Don't be surprised by questions about your age, family, or salary — it's ordinary friendly curiosity, and you can just laugh it off. Popular hobbies in China: hiking (爬山), badminton, photography, fishing, and, for the older generation, square dancing (广场舞). The contact is almost always WeChat, not a phone number.

quiz.q: How is it more natural to reply to "你的中文真好！"?
quiz.explain: Modestly deflecting a compliment is the polite norm in China.

quiz.q: What does "我是个吃货" mean?
quiz.explain: 吃货 — playfully, "foodie, glutton"; people say it about themselves with pride.

quiz.q: How do you say "I'm interested in calligraphy"?
quiz.explain: The correct pattern: 对 + object + 感兴趣.

quiz.q: How do people usually swap contacts when they meet in China?
options: They hand over a business card with an email
They add each other on WeChat via a QR code
quiz.explain: 加个微信吧 — the standard; one person scans the other's QR code.

role.ai_role: Xiao Chen, a 26-year-old designer from Hangzhou at a language exchange: friendly, asks lots of questions, and loves photography
role.user_goal: get to know her, tell her about yourself and two of your hobbies, find out about her interests, and arrange to do something together by adding each other on WeChat
role.opening: 你好！我是小陈，第一次来语言交换吗？你中文说得不错嘛！
checklist: introduce yourself (name, where you're from)
modestly respond to a compliment (哪里哪里 and the like)
tell her about at least two hobbies
ask about her hobbies (你有什么爱好？/周末你一般做什么？)
suggest meeting up and adding each other on WeChat

topics.title: Chinese cuisine: dishes and how to order
topics.intro: Food is China's greatest passion and the best reason to start a conversation. We'll go through the names of popular dishes, how to order via a QR code or from a waiter, ask for no spice and no cilantro, pay, and take leftovers home.

phrases.py: Nǐmen de zhāopái cài shì shénme?
Sǎo zhuō shang de èrwéimǎ diǎn cān.
phrases.ru: You order through a QR code on the table.
phrases.note: That's how most cafés work now: the menu opens in WeChat or Alipay.
Calling the waiter loudly is normal. Many people simply say "你好！" or "服务员！".

phrases.ru: One order of kung pao chicken.
phrases.note: 来 + quantity is the liveliest way to order.

phrases.py: Wǒ bù néng chī là, shǎo fàng diǎn là.
phrases.ru: I can't eat spicy food, please go easy on the chili.
Just a little spicy is fine.
phrases.note: Careful: in Sichuan and Hunan, "微辣" is still fairly spicy.

phrases.py: Zhège cài gòu jǐ ge rén chī?
phrases.ru: How many people does this dish feed?
And two more bowls of rice.
phrases.note: Rice is often ordered separately and brought toward the end.

phrases.py: Lái yì píng píjiǔ, yào bīng de.
phrases.ru: A bottle of beer, cold please.
phrases.note: If you don't specify, the drink may be served at room temperature.

phrases.ru: Can I get this packed to go?
phrases.note: Taking leftovers home is perfectly normal — nobody will judge you.

dialogue.zh: 你好，有菜单吗？
dialogue.py: Nǐ hǎo, yǒu càidān ma?
dialogue.ru: Hello, do you have a menu?

dialogue.zh: 扫一下桌上的二维码就可以点了。
dialogue.py: Sǎo yíxià zhuō shang de èrwéimǎ jiù kěyǐ diǎn le.
dialogue.ru: Scan the QR code on the table and you can start ordering.

dialogue.zh: 好的。你们的招牌菜是什么？
dialogue.py: Hǎo de. Nǐmen de zhāopái cài shì shénme?
dialogue.ru: Okay. And what's your signature dish?

dialogue.zh: 我们家的麻婆豆腐和水煮鱼都很有名。
dialogue.py: Wǒmen jiā de mápó dòufu hé shuǐzhǔ yú dōu hěn yǒumíng.
dialogue.ru: We're famous for mapo tofu and shuizhu fish.

dialogue.zh: 麻婆豆腐辣吗？我不太能吃辣。
dialogue.py: Mápó dòufu là ma? Wǒ bú tài néng chī là.
dialogue.ru: Is the mapo tofu spicy? I don't handle spicy food very well.

dialogue.zh: 有点儿辣，可以给您做微辣的。
dialogue.py: Yǒu diǎnr là, kěyǐ gěi nín zuò wēi là de.
dialogue.ru: It's a little spicy, but we can make it mildly spicy for you.

dialogue.zh: 好，来一个微辣的麻婆豆腐，再来两碗米饭。别放香菜，谢谢！
dialogue.py: Hǎo, lái yí ge wēi là de mápó dòufu, zài lái liǎng wǎn mǐfàn. Bié fàng xiāngcài, xièxie!
dialogue.ru: Great, one mildly spicy mapo tofu and two bowls of rice. No cilantro, thanks!

dialogue.zh: 好的，请稍等。
dialogue.py: Hǎo de, qǐng shāo děng.
dialogue.ru: Okay, please wait a moment.

topics.culture: In China, dishes are ordered for the whole table and eaten together; a good rule is one more dish than the number of people. Don't stick your chopsticks upright in your rice — that's how incense is placed for the dead. People often "fight" over the bill, and it's usually the person who invited who pays; splitting the bill equally (AA制) is fine among young people and friends. Tipping is not customary. Try the classics: 北京烤鸭 (Peking duck), 小笼包 (xiaolongbao), 火锅 (hotpot), 饺子 (jiaozi), 宫保鸡丁 (kung pao chicken).

quiz.q: How do you ask for a dish without cilantro?
quiz.explain: 不要放 + ingredient — "don't put in…".

quiz.q: What does "买单" mean?
quiz.explain: 买单 — to ask for the check; 打包 — to go; 菜单 — menu.

quiz.q: Why shouldn't you stick chopsticks upright in your rice?
options: It resembles incense at a funeral
It's a sign that you didn't like the food
quiz.explain: Chopsticks in rice are associated with offerings to the dead.

quiz.q: You ordered "微辣" in Chengdu. What should you expect?
options: The dish will still be noticeably spicy
quiz.explain: 微辣 — "mildly spicy," but by Sichuan standards; for a beginner it's often quite hot.

role.ai_role: a waitress in a busy Sichuan restaurant in Chengdu, quick but friendly, actively recommends dishes
role.user_goal: order dinner for two: ask about the signature dish, ask for mildly spicy and no cilantro, order rice and a drink, and at the end ask for the check and for the leftovers to be packed up
role.opening: 欢迎光临！几位？桌上有二维码，可以扫码点餐，要不要我给您推荐几个菜？
checklist: ask about the signature dish or for a recommendation
order at least two dishes with quantities (来一份…)
ask for less spice and no cilantro
order rice or a drink
ask for the check (买单) and for packing to go (打包)

topics.title: Holidays: Chunjie, Mid-Autumn, Duanwu
topics.intro: China's three main traditional holidays — the Lunar New Year, the Mid-Autumn Festival, and the Dragon Boat Festival. You'll learn to greet friends and colleagues, understand what people eat and how they celebrate, and avoid blunders with red envelopes.

phrases.note: A warm, conversational greeting for Chunjie, especially when you meet someone.
A Chunjie classic. Children and friends often reply playfully: "红包拿来！"
Only as a joke, and among close friends.

phrases.zh: 祝你身体健康，万事如意！
phrases.py: Zhù nǐ shēntǐ jiànkāng, wànshì rúyì!
phrases.ru: Wishing you good health and all the best!

phrases.zh: 祝你新的一年心想事成！
phrases.py: Zhù nǐ xīn de yì nián xīn xiǎng shì chéng!
phrases.ru: May all your wishes come true in the new year!
Are you going back to your hometown for the New Year?
phrases.note: The most common question before Chunjie: millions of people travel to see their parents.

phrases.zh: 除夕晚上一家人一起吃年夜饭。
phrases.py: Chúxī wǎnshang yì jiā rén yìqǐ chī niányèfàn.
phrases.ru: On New Year's Eve, the whole family has a festive dinner together.

phrases.zh: 我在微信群里发了个红包。
phrases.py: Wǒ zài Wēixìn qún li fā le ge hóngbāo.
phrases.ru: I sent a red envelope to the WeChat group.
phrases.note: 抢红包 — "grabbing" red envelopes in a chat, a favorite holiday pastime.

phrases.py: Chūnyùn de piào tèbié nán mǎi.
phrases.ru: Tickets during chunyun are really hard to get.
phrases.note: 春运 — the biggest annual migration of people for the holidays.

phrases.py: Jīnwǎn de yuèliang zhēn yuán a!
phrases.ru: The moon is so round tonight!
phrases.note: The full moon is a symbol of family reunion (团圆).

phrases.zh: 你喜欢什么馅儿的月饼？
phrases.py: Nǐ xǐhuan shénme xiànr de yuèbing?
phrases.ru: What kind of mooncake filling do you like?
Wishing you a peaceful and happy Duanwu Festival!
phrases.note: Many people prefer 安康 to 快乐 because the festival is linked to the memory of the poet Qu Yuan; "快乐" is also said.

phrases.zh: 你吃甜粽子还是咸粽子？
phrases.py: Nǐ chī tián zòngzi háishi xián zòngzi?
phrases.ru: Do you eat sweet or savory zongzi?
phrases.note: The eternal debate between the north (sweet) and the south (savory, with meat).

phrases.py: Yìqǐ qù kàn lóngzhōu bǐsài ba!
phrases.ru: Let's go watch the dragon boat races!

dialogue.zh: 王老师，过年好！祝您新年快乐！
dialogue.py: Wáng lǎoshī, guònián hǎo! Zhù nín xīnnián kuàilè!
dialogue.ru: Teacher Wang, happy holiday! Happy New Year!

dialogue.zh: 过年好！恭喜发财！你今年回老家过年吗？
dialogue.py: Guònián hǎo! Gōngxǐ fācái! Nǐ jīnnián huí lǎojiā guònián ma?
dialogue.ru: Happy holiday! Wishing you wealth! Are you going home for the New Year?

dialogue.zh: 回啊，我买到高铁票了，除夕前一天到家。
dialogue.py: Huí a, wǒ mǎi dào gāotiě piào le, chúxī qián yì tiān dào jiā.
dialogue.ru: I am. I bought a high-speed train ticket and will be home the day before New Year's Eve.

dialogue.zh: 真不容易！春运的票特别难买。
dialogue.py: Zhēn bù róngyì! Chūnyùn de piào tèbié nán mǎi.
dialogue.ru: Wow, that's not easy! Tickets are really hard to get during chunyun.

dialogue.zh: 是啊。您今年怎么过？
dialogue.py: Shì a. Nín jīnnián zěnme guò?
dialogue.ru: They sure are. And how will you celebrate?

dialogue.zh: 在家跟家人吃年夜饭，看春晚，包饺子。
dialogue.py: Zài jiā gēn jiārén chī niányèfàn, kàn Chūnwǎn, bāo jiǎozi.
dialogue.ru: At home with my family: the New Year's Eve dinner, the New Year gala on TV, and making jiaozi together.

dialogue.zh: 真热闹！祝您身体健康，万事如意！
dialogue.py: Zhēn rènao! Zhù nín shēntǐ jiànkāng, wànshì rúyì!
dialogue.ru: How fun! Wishing you good health and success in everything!

dialogue.zh: 谢谢！也祝你新的一年心想事成！
dialogue.py: Xièxie! Yě zhù nǐ xīn de yì nián xīn xiǎng shì chéng!
dialogue.ru: Thank you! And to you — may all your wishes come true in the new year!

topics.culture: Holiday dates follow the lunar calendar: Chunjie falls between late January and February, the Mid-Autumn Festival (the 15th day of the 8th month) in September to early October, and Duanwu (the 5th day of the 5th month) in May to June. In 2026, according to the PRC State Council schedule: Chunjie — February 17 (days off February 15–23), Duanwu — June 19 (days off June 19–21), Mid-Autumn — September 25 (days off September 25–27). In 2027, by the lunar calendar: Chunjie — February 6, Qingming — April 5, Duanwu — June 9, Mid-Autumn — September 15; the State Council publishes the 2027 holiday schedule separately (usually at the end of the previous year) — check gov.cn. A red envelope (红包) is filled with new banknotes in an even amount, avoiding the number 4; the easiest way is to send a 红包 on WeChat. Don't give money in a white envelope — white is associated with mourning. At Mid-Autumn it's customary to give mooncakes (月饼) to colleagues and partners, and at Duanwu people eat zongzi — rice wrapped in bamboo leaves.

quiz.q: Which greeting is typical for Chunjie?
quiz.explain: 恭喜发财 — a wish for wealth, a classic of the Lunar New Year.

quiz.q: What do people eat at the Mid-Autumn Festival?
quiz.explain: 月饼 — mooncakes; 粽子 are eaten at Duanwu, and 饺子 at Chunjie (especially in the north).

quiz.q: Why do many people say "安康" rather than "快乐" at Duanwu?
options: The festival is linked to the memory of the poet Qu Yuan
quiz.explain: Out of respect for the festival's commemorative origin, people wish "peace and health."

quiz.q: What amount is best to put in a 红包?
quiz.explain: An even amount without fours, new banknotes, a red envelope.

role.ai_role: your Chinese friend Xiao Mei, who writes to you a few days before Chunjie during a WeChat video call, cheerful and chatty
role.user_goal: congratulate her on the coming New Year with two different wishes, ask how she will celebrate, and tell her that you sent her a 红包
role.opening: 嗨！马上就要过年了，我刚抢到回老家的高铁票！你知道中国人怎么过年吗？
checklist: offer greetings (新年快乐/过年好/恭喜发财)
wish her health or luck with a longer phrase (祝你…)
ask whether she is going home and what she will eat
mention 红包 or 年夜饭
answer her question about the holidays in Russia

topics.title: Traveling in China: cities and sights
topics.intro: The Great Wall, the Forbidden City, pandas in Chengdu, and West Lake in Hangzhou — China is huge and varied. You'll learn to ask for directions, book tickets, ask someone to take your photo, and find out from locals what to see and try.

phrases.py: Wǒ xiǎng qù Běijīng kàn Chángchéng.
phrases.ru: I want to go to Beijing to see the Great Wall.

phrases.zh: 有什么好玩儿的地方推荐吗？
phrases.py: Yǒu shénme hǎowánr de dìfang tuījiàn ma?
phrases.ru: Can you recommend any fun places?

phrases.py: Qù Gùgōng yào tíqián yùyuē ma?
phrases.ru: Do I need to book in advance to visit the Forbidden City?
phrases.note: Yes: tickets are named (for foreigners, by passport), sold online on the museum's official website, and not sold on the day of the visit; sales open 7 days ahead at 20:00, and in season tickets sell out quickly. The museum is closed on Mondays (except on public holidays).

phrases.ru: How much is the admission ticket?
Excuse me, how do I get to the subway station?

phrases.zh: 我买了一张去西安的高铁票。
phrases.py: Wǒ mǎi le yì zhāng qù Xī'ān de gāotiě piào.
phrases.ru: I bought a high-speed train ticket to Xi'an.
phrases.note: In Xi'an, there's the Terracotta Army (兵马俑).

phrases.py: Bāng wǒmen pāi zhāng zhào, kěyǐ ma?
phrases.ru: Could you take a photo of us?
What local snacks are worth trying here?

phrases.py: Wǒ dìng le yì jiā mínsù.
phrases.note: 民宿 — a guesthouse, often cozier and cheaper than a hotel.

phrases.ru: There are too many people here!

phrases.zh: 我迷路了，能帮我一下吗？
phrases.py: Wǒ mílù le, néng bāng wǒ yíxià ma?
phrases.ru: I'm lost — could you help me?

phrases.py: Shàng yǒu tiāntáng, xià yǒu Sū Háng.
phrases.ru: Above is heaven, below are Suzhou and Hangzhou.
phrases.note: An old saying; locals will be delighted if you remember it.

dialogue.zh: 你好，我第一次来成都，有什么好玩儿的地方推荐吗？
dialogue.py: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ dì-yī cì lái Chéngdū, yǒu shénme hǎowánr de dìfang tuījiàn ma?
dialogue.ru: Hello, it's my first time in Chengdu — what do you recommend seeing?

dialogue.zh: 一定要去看大熊猫！熊猫基地早上去最好，熊猫比较活跃。
dialogue.py: Yídìng yào qù kàn dà xióngmāo! Xióngmāo jīdì zǎoshang qù zuì hǎo, xióngmāo bǐjiào huóyuè.
dialogue.ru: You must see the pandas! It's best to go to the panda base in the morning — they're more active.

dialogue.zh: 门票要提前买吗？
dialogue.py: Ménpiào yào tíqián mǎi ma?
dialogue.ru: Do I need to buy tickets in advance?

dialogue.zh: 最好在网上提前预约，周末人很多。
dialogue.py: Zuì hǎo zài wǎng shang tíqián yùyuē, zhōumò rén hěn duō.
dialogue.ru: It's better to book online ahead of time; there are a lot of people on weekends.

dialogue.zh: 好的。这儿附近有什么特色小吃？
dialogue.py: Hǎo de. Zhèr fùjìn yǒu shénme tèsè xiǎochī?
dialogue.ru: I see. And what local snacks are there nearby?

dialogue.zh: 宽窄巷子和锦里有很多，比如串串和钟水饺。
dialogue.py: Kuānzhǎi Xiàngzi hé Jǐnlǐ yǒu hěn duō, bǐrú chuànchuàn hé Zhōng shuǐjiǎo.
dialogue.ru: Kuanzhai Alley and Jinli are full of them — for example, chuanchuan and Zhong dumplings.

dialogue.zh: 听起来太好吃了！离这儿远吗？
dialogue.py: Tīng qǐlái tài hǎochī le! Lí zhèr yuǎn ma?
dialogue.ru: That sounds delicious! Is it far from here?

dialogue.zh: 不远，坐地铁二十分钟就到。
dialogue.py: Bù yuǎn, zuò dìtiě èrshí fēnzhōng jiù dào.
dialogue.ru: Not far, about twenty minutes by subway.

topics.culture: Tickets to almost all popular places are bought online in advance (often through WeChat mini programs) using a passport number — take your passport with you, since your document is scanned at the entrance. Avoid traveling during the National Day "Golden Week" (early October; in 2026, days off are October 1–7) and at Chunjie: the crowds are huge and hotel prices skyrocket. Foreigners can link a foreign card to Alipay and WeChat Pay — you hardly need cash. By a PRC decision, citizens of Russia with an ordinary passport can enter visa-free for up to 30 days until December 31, 2027 (tourism, business, visiting relatives, exchanges, transit); the rules may change — check the website of the PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs or the PRC Embassy in Russia before you travel. Don't be surprised if Chinese tourists ask to take a photo with you — it's a sign of friendliness.

quiz.q: How do you ask whether you need to book in advance?
quiz.explain: 提前预约 — to book in advance.

quiz.q: What must you bring on a visit to the Gugong?
quiz.explain: Tickets are named, and your passport is scanned at the entrance.

quiz.q: Which cities are in the saying "上有天堂，下有苏杭"?
quiz.explain: 苏 — Suzhou, 杭 — Hangzhou, cities of gardens and West Lake.

quiz.q: When is it best NOT to travel in China?
quiz.explain: The 国庆 Golden Week is the peak of domestic tourism (in 2026, days off are October 1–7 according to the State Council schedule).

role.ai_role: the manager of a guesthouse (民宿) in Xi'an, hospitable, proud of the city, and fond of giving advice
role.user_goal: find out what to see in Xi'an in two days, how to get to the Terracotta Army, whether you need to book tickets, and what local food to try
role.opening: 欢迎来西安！一路辛苦了。这是您第一次来吗？打算玩儿几天？
checklist: say how many days you're in the city
ask for recommendations (有什么推荐…)
ask about tickets/booking
ask for directions or the distance (怎么走/远吗)
ask about local food (特色小吃)

topics.title: Movies and TV series: popular phrases and slang
topics.intro: Chinese dramas are watched all over the world, and discussing them with Chinese people is great practice. You'll learn to talk about series, actors, and plot in lively language: "hooked," "don't spoil it," "soap opera," "rewatched it all night."

phrases.py: Nǐ zuìjìn zài zhuī shénme jù?
phrases.ru: What series are you watching right now?
phrases.note: 追剧 — "chasing a series," watching episodes as they come out.

phrases.py: Wǒ zài zhuī yí bù gǔzhuāng jù.
phrases.ru: I'm watching a historical costume drama.

phrases.py: Zhè bù jù tài shàngtóu le!
phrases.note: 上头 — "it hit my head," about something very gripping.

phrases.py: Wǒ zuótiān áoyè shuā jù le.
phrases.ru: I stayed up all night yesterday binge-watching a series.
phrases.note: 刷剧 — to watch episode after episode.
颜值 — "looks index."

phrases.ru: The plot is way too melodramatic.
phrases.note: 狗血 — contrived drama: amnesia, evil mothers-in-law, switched babies.
虐 — painfully sad for the viewer.

phrases.ru: The series has a terrible ending.

phrases.note: 磕CP — to root for a pair of characters or actors.

phrases.py: Wǒ xǐhuan kāi zhe dànmù kàn.
phrases.ru: I like to watch with the live comments turned on.
phrases.note: 弹幕 — viewers' comments flying across the screen.
Douban is one of China's main sites for ratings of movies, series, and books.

phrases.py: Zhōumò yìqǐ qù kàn diànyǐng ba?
phrases.ru: Shall we go to the movies this weekend?

dialogue.zh: 你最近在追什么剧？
dialogue.py: Nǐ zuìjìn zài zhuī shénme jù?
dialogue.ru: What are you watching now?

dialogue.zh: 一部古装剧，太上头了，昨天熬夜刷了五集。
dialogue.py: Yí bù gǔzhuāng jù, tài shàngtóu le, zuótiān áoyè shuā le wǔ jí.
dialogue.ru: A historical series, insanely addictive — yesterday I watched five episodes until late at night.

dialogue.zh: 哈哈，我也在看！男主颜值超高。
dialogue.py: Hāha, wǒ yě zài kàn! Nánzhǔ yánzhí chāo gāo.
dialogue.ru: Ha-ha, I'm watching it too! The main hero is so handsome.

dialogue.zh: 不过剧情有点儿狗血……
dialogue.py: Búguò jùqíng yǒu diǎnr gǒuxiě……
dialogue.ru: True, though the plot is a bit melodramatic…

dialogue.zh: 别剧透啊！我才看到第十集。
dialogue.py: Bié jùtòu a! Wǒ cái kàn dào dì-shí jí.
dialogue.ru: Don't spoil it! I'm only on episode ten.

dialogue.zh: 好好好，不说了。你喜欢开弹幕吗？
dialogue.py: Hǎo hǎo hǎo, bù shuō le. Nǐ xǐhuan kāi dànmù ma?
dialogue.ru: Okay, okay, my lips are sealed. Do you watch with the live comments on?

dialogue.zh: 喜欢，有时候弹幕比剧还好笑，笑死我了。
dialogue.py: Xǐhuan, yǒu shíhou dànmù bǐ jù hái hǎoxiào, xiào sǐ wǒ le.
dialogue.ru: Yes, sometimes the comments are funnier than the series itself — I'm dying of laughter.

dialogue.zh: 周末一起去电影院看新片吧？
dialogue.py: Zhōumò yìqǐ qù diànyǐngyuàn kàn xīn piàn ba?
dialogue.ru: Shall we go to the cinema this weekend to see the new movie?

topics.culture: In China, series are watched on the platforms 爱奇艺 (iQIYI), 腾讯视频, 优酷, and B站 (Bilibili); many people watch at faster speed (倍速). Chinese dramas are long — 30–40 episodes or more — and there's now a boom in "short dramas" (短剧) with vertical episodes a few minutes long. Almost everything comes with Chinese subtitles — a huge plus for learners: you can read and listen at the same time. The most popular genres: 古装 (historical), 仙侠 (fantasy about immortals), 甜宠 ("sweet" romance), and detective stories.

quiz.q: What does "别剧透！" mean?
quiz.explain: 剧透 — spoiler; 别 — "don't."

quiz.q: The series "太狗血了" is…
quiz.explain: 狗血 — "dog blood," the term for soap-opera plot twists.

quiz.q: What is 弹幕?
quiz.explain: 弹幕 — "bullet screen," scrolling comments, especially popular on Bilibili.

quiz.q: How do you say "I watched a series all night"?
quiz.explain: 熬夜 — to stay up late, 刷剧 — to watch episode after episode.

role.ai_role: Xiao Yu, a student from Beijing, a fan of dramas and live comments, who speaks emotionally and with plenty of slang
role.user_goal: chat about TV series: say what you're watching (the genre, without quoting lines), rate the plot and actors using slang, ask her not to spoil it, and agree to go to the movies
role.opening: 啊啊啊我昨天又熬夜刷剧了，太上头了！你最近在追什么剧？
checklist: name the genre of what you're watching (古装剧/爱情剧…)
use at least two slang words (上头/狗血/颜值/虐…)
ask her not to spoil it (别剧透)
ask about the rating or 弹幕
suggest going to the movies

topics.title: Tea and the tea ceremony
topics.intro: Tea in China is a daily habit, an art, and a great gift all at once. You'll learn about types of tea, how to behave at the tea table, and how to buy tea in a shop with a tasting — and also how to order trendy milk tea.

phrases.ru: What kind of tea do you like?
I like green tea, for example Longjing.
What kind of tea is this?
It's a little bitter, but it leaves a sweet aftertaste.
phrases.note: 回甘 — the sweetness that comes after a sip; the highest compliment for a good tea.

phrases.ru: The first infusion is for rinsing the tea.
phrases.note: This is done with oolongs and pu'erhs; green tea is usually not rinsed.

phrases.py: Zhège chá néng pào jǐ pào?
phrases.ru: How many infusions can this tea take?

phrases.note: In tea shops, tastings are the norm — they'll sit you down and serve you tea.
斤 = 500 g. Tea prices are almost always given per jin.

phrases.zh: 我想买点儿茶叶送朋友。
phrases.py: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi diǎnr cháyè sòng péngyou.
phrases.ru: I'd like to buy some tea as a gift for a friend.
Can you pack it in a gift box?
Thank you, that's enough for me.
Take your time and savor it.

phrases.zh: 我要一杯珍珠奶茶，少糖，去冰。
phrases.py: Wǒ yào yì bēi zhēnzhū nǎichá, shǎo táng, qù bīng.
phrases.ru: One bubble tea, less sugar, no ice.
phrases.note: Tea chains always ask about sugar (全糖/半糖/少糖/无糖) and ice (正常冰/少冰/去冰/热).

dialogue.zh: 欢迎！请坐，先喝杯茶吧。
dialogue.py: Huānyíng! Qǐng zuò, xiān hē bēi chá ba.
dialogue.ru: Welcome! Please sit down and have some tea first.

dialogue.zh: 谢谢！这是什么茶？好香啊！
dialogue.py: Xièxie! Zhè shì shénme chá? Hǎo xiāng a!
dialogue.ru: Thank you! What kind of tea is this? What a fragrance!

dialogue.zh: 这是安溪铁观音。第一泡是洗茶，这是第二泡，您尝尝。
dialogue.py: Zhè shì Ānxī tiěguānyīn. Dì-yī pào shì xǐ chá, zhè shì dì-èr pào, nín chángchang.
dialogue.ru: This is Tieguanyin from Anxi. The first infusion is the rinse; this is the second, give it a try.

dialogue.zh: 嗯，有点儿苦，但是回甘很明显。
dialogue.py: Ng, yǒu diǎnr kǔ, dànshì huígān hěn míngxiǎn.
dialogue.ru: Mm, it's a little bitter, but the sweet aftertaste is very distinct.

dialogue.zh: 您很懂茶啊！这个茶能泡七八泡。
dialogue.py: Nín hěn dǒng chá a! Zhège chá néng pào qī bā pào.
dialogue.ru: You really know your tea! It lasts seven or eight infusions.

dialogue.zh: 我想买点儿送朋友，一斤多少钱？
dialogue.py: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi diǎnr sòng péngyou, yì jīn duōshao qián?
dialogue.ru: I'd like to buy some as a gift for a friend. How much is a jin?

dialogue.zh: 这款三百八一斤，礼盒另加二十。
dialogue.py: Zhè kuǎn sānbǎi bā yì jīn, lǐhé lìng jiā èrshí.
dialogue.ru: This one is 380 a jin, and the gift box is twenty extra.

dialogue.zh: 好，要半斤，用礼盒装吧。
dialogue.py: Hǎo, yào bàn jīn, yòng lǐhé zhuāng ba.
dialogue.ru: Okay, half a jin, packed in a gift box please.

topics.culture: China has six main categories of tea: green (绿茶), white (白茶), yellow (黄茶), oolong (乌龙茶), "red" (红茶 — what English speakers call black tea), and "black" (黑茶, for example ripe pu'erh). When someone refills your tea, you can lightly tap the table twice with your bent fingers as a sign of thanks (叩手礼) — this is especially common in the south. A cup is filled to about 70%: there's a saying "茶满欺客" — a cup filled to the brim is impolite to a guest. If you don't want any more, leave the tea in your cup — an empty cup will be refilled again and again.

quiz.q: What does a Chinese person call 红茶?
options: Black tea (as English speakers understand it)
quiz.explain: 红茶 — "red" by the color of the infusion; in English it is "black" tea.

quiz.q: How do you silently thank someone who has refilled your tea?
options: Raise the cup above your head
Lightly tap your fingers on the table
quiz.explain: 叩手礼 — finger tapping, a gesture of thanks.

quiz.q: How many grams are in one 斤?
quiz.explain: 1 斤 = 500 g; tea prices are almost always per jin.

quiz.q: What does "回甘" mean?
quiz.explain: 回甘 — the sweetness that returns after a sip, a sign of quality tea.

role.ai_role: the owner of a tea shop in Hangzhou, an unhurried tea connoisseur who loves to tell stories and offer tastings
role.user_goal: try two kinds of tea, comment on the taste and aroma, find out the price per jin, and buy tea as a gift in gift packaging
role.opening: 来来来，请坐！先尝尝我们今年的新茶。您平时喜欢喝什么茶？
checklist: say what kind of tea you like
ask what kind of tea it is and describe the taste (香/苦/回甘)
say thanks or politely stop the refilling (够了)
ask the price per 斤
buy a certain amount in a gift box

topics.title: Zodiac signs and superstitions
topics.intro: "What's your sign?" is a common question when you meet someone in China. You'll learn about the twelve animals, the "benming" year, lucky and unlucky numbers, and gifts you should never give to Chinese friends.

phrases.ru: What animal are you by birth year?
phrases.note: This is a tactful way to find out someone's age: if you know the animal, it's easy to work out the birth year.

phrases.py: Èr líng èr liù nián shì mǎ nián.
phrases.ru: 2026 is the year of the Horse.
phrases.note: The Year of the Horse (丙午) in the lunar calendar began with Chunjie — February 17, 2026, not January 1; on February 6, 2027, the Year of the Goat/Sheep (丁未, 羊年) will begin. Some people in traditional astrology change the animal at the 立春 season (around February 4).
本命年 — the year of your own animal, once every 12 years; it is considered "dangerous."

phrases.ru: In your own year, you have to wear red.
phrases.note: Red underwear, socks, or a string on the wrist are worn as a protective charm.
Western astrology is also very popular among young people.

phrases.py: Bā tīng qǐlái xiàng "fā", hěn jílì.
phrases.ru: "Eight" sounds like "to get rich" — a very lucky number.

phrases.note: Six is a symbol of smoothness and success.

phrases.py: Sòng lǐ bù néng sòng zhōng.
phrases.ru: You can't give clocks (wall or desk) as gifts.
phrases.note: 送钟 (giving a clock) sounds like 送终 (seeing someone off on their final journey).

phrases.py: Bié sòng sǎn, yě bié fēn lí chī.
phrases.ru: Don't give an umbrella and don't split a pear.
phrases.note: 伞 sǎn ≈ 散 sàn "to part ways," 分梨 ≈ 分离 "separation."

phrases.ru: The color red means joy and celebration.
Just for luck, for a good omen.
phrases.note: A common answer: people don't really believe in omens, but follow them "just in case."

dialogue.zh: 你属什么？
dialogue.py: Nǐ shǔ shénme?
dialogue.ru: What animal are you by birth year?

dialogue.zh: 我属马，今年是我的本命年。
dialogue.py: Wǒ shǔ mǎ, jīnnián shì wǒ de běnmìngnián.
dialogue.ru: I'm a Horse, and this year is my benming year.

dialogue.zh: 本命年要注意什么吗？
dialogue.py: Běnmìngnián yào zhùyì shénme ma?
dialogue.ru: And do you have to observe anything in your own year?

dialogue.zh: 老人说要穿红色，所以我买了红袜子，哈哈。
dialogue.py: Lǎorén shuō yào chuān hóngsè, suǒyǐ wǒ mǎi le hóng wàzi, hāha.
dialogue.ru: The older folks say you should wear red, so I bought red socks, ha-ha.

dialogue.zh: 你信这个吗？
dialogue.py: Nǐ xìn zhège ma?
dialogue.ru: Do you believe in this?

dialogue.zh: 半信半疑吧，图个吉利嘛。
dialogue.py: Bàn xìn bàn yí ba, tú ge jílì ma.
dialogue.ru: Half and half. Just for luck.

dialogue.zh: 我想给中国朋友送一个漂亮的钟，可以吗？
dialogue.py: Wǒ xiǎng gěi Zhōngguó péngyou sòng yí ge piàoliang de zhōng, kěyǐ ma?
dialogue.ru: I want to give a Chinese friend a beautiful clock — is that okay?

dialogue.zh: 千万别！“送钟”听起来像“送终”，不吉利。
dialogue.py: Qiānwàn bié! "Sòng zhōng" tīng qǐlái xiàng "sòngzhōng", bù jílì.
dialogue.ru: Absolutely not! "Giving a clock" sounds like "seeing someone off on their final journey" — it's a bad omen.

dialogue.zh: 原来如此！那送什么好呢？
dialogue.py: Yuánlái rúcǐ! Nà sòng shénme hǎo ne?
dialogue.ru: I see! So what's better to give?

dialogue.zh: 送茶叶或者水果都不错，别送梨就行。
dialogue.py: Sòng cháyè huòzhě shuǐguǒ dōu búcuò, bié sòng lí jiù xíng.
dialogue.ru: Tea or fruit is great, just not pears.

topics.culture: Many superstitions are built on similar sounds: buildings often have no 4th and 14th floors (and sometimes no 13th), and phone numbers and license plates with eights cost more. The Beijing Olympics opened on August 8, 2008, at 8 p.m. (08.08.2008) — no accident! Money and gifts are given in even amounts (except for four), and white and black wrapping is associated with mourning. 520 (wǔ èr líng) sounds similar to 我爱你, so May 20 is an unofficial Valentine's Day in China. A gift is usually not opened right away in front of the giver, and people may politely refuse a couple of times before accepting.

quiz.q: What does "你属什么？" mean?
options: Which animal are you by birth year?
What is your zodiac sign by month?
quiz.explain: 属 + animal — birth year in the 12-year cycle; the Western sign is 星座.

quiz.q: Why shouldn't you give a Chinese person a wall clock?
options: 送钟 sounds like 送终 — "seeing someone off on their final journey"
Clocks are considered a women's gift
quiz.explain: Homophony: 钟 zhōng / 终 zhōng.

quiz.q: Which number is considered the luckiest for money?
quiz.explain: 八 bā sounds like 发 fā — "to get rich."

quiz.q: What do people wear in their 本命年?
quiz.explain: Red is a charm against bad luck in your "own" year.

role.ai_role: Auntie Li, a retired neighbor in Beijing, good-natured, who loves omens and advice
role.user_goal: find out her animal by birth year and name your own, ask about 本命年, and get advice on what to give her grandson for his birthday without breaking any omens
role.opening: 哎呀，小伙子/姑娘，今天穿得真精神！你多大了？属什么的呀？
checklist: name your own animal (我属…)
ask her animal and about 本命年
mention at least one lucky or unlucky number
ask what you can and can't give as a gift
react politely to advice (原来如此/谢谢您)

topics.title: Internet slang and emoji on WeChat
topics.intro: Chinese chats are full of numbers, abbreviations, and stickers: 666, yyds, 88, 哈哈哈. You'll learn to understand and use popular slang on WeChat appropriately, and not offend the other person with an "innocent" emoji.

phrases.note: The more 哈, the funnier. But 呵呵 often sounds cold or sarcastic.
From gamer slang: 溜 liù — "slick, smooth."

phrases.ru: Come on! Hang in there! Good luck!
phrases.note: Literally "add gas." Fits before an exam, work, or a competition.
牛 — "ox," and in slang, "cool, powerful."
Short for 永远的神 — "eternal deity."

phrases.ru: Things are so hard for me.
phrases.note: Self-deprecating humor about life's difficulties.
A standard reply in chats, especially work chats.
Cute and friendly. A dry "好。" or a lone "哦。" can seem cold.
A doubled 哦哦 sounds warmer than a single "哦."
88 sounds like 拜拜 (bye-bye).
It sounds like 我爱你; May 20 (5.20) is an unofficial day for declarations of love: people give gifts and send symbolic sums, for example 5.20 or 520 yuan.

phrases.ru: I'm so moved (it got me emotionally).
phrases.note: "Defenses broken" — when something moves you to tears or hits you hard.

phrases.ru: Forget it all, let's just relax.
phrases.note: 躺平 — "lying flat," opting out of the race for success.

phrases.ru: The competition is crazy right now.
phrases.note: 内卷 — an exhausting competition where everyone works harder and nobody gets ahead.
斗图 — chatting using only meme stickers (表情包).

dialogue.zh: 我HSK四级过了！！
dialogue.py: Wǒ HSK sì jí guò le!!
dialogue.ru: I passed HSK 4!!

dialogue.py: Liù liù liù! Tài niú le!
dialogue.ru: Wow! You're amazing!

dialogue.zh: 哈哈哈，考前一个月天天熬夜，我太难了。
dialogue.py: Hāhāhā, kǎo qián yí ge yuè tiāntiān áoyè, wǒ tài nán le.
dialogue.ru: Ha-ha-ha, for a month before the exam I stayed up late every day, it was so hard.

dialogue.zh: 你是yyds！要不要庆祝一下？
dialogue.py: Nǐ shì yyds! Yào bu yào qìngzhù yíxià?
dialogue.ru: You're a legend! Shall we celebrate?

dialogue.zh: 好呀！周六吃火锅？
dialogue.py: Hǎo ya! Zhōuliù chī huǒguō?
dialogue.ru: Sure! Hotpot on Saturday?

dialogue.zh: 收到！我来订位子。
dialogue.py: Shōudào! Wǒ lái dìng wèizi.
dialogue.ru: Got it! I'll book a table.

dialogue.zh: 好哒～谢谢！加油工作哦！
dialogue.py: Hǎo da~ Xièxie! Jiāyóu gōngzuò o!
dialogue.ru: Okay~ Thanks! Good luck at work!

dialogue.zh: 不客气，88！
dialogue.py: Bú kèqi, bā bā!
dialogue.ru: You're welcome, bye-bye!

topics.culture: Be careful with the standard 🙂 emoji "微笑" on WeChat: young people take it as a cold, passive-aggressive, or sarcastic smirk, so use 😂, 捂脸 (facepalm), or stickers instead. The same goes for "呵呵" — it's more of a "yeah, right" than laughter; to show laughter, write 哈哈哈. Chinese people love voice messages (语音) and meme stickers (表情包), and during holidays they "grab" red envelopes in group chats (抢红包). Slang like 内卷 and 躺平 is a living part of the language, but it's better to avoid it in formal correspondence.

quiz.q: How do young Chinese people often take the 🙂 (微笑) emoji on WeChat?
options: As a cold or sarcastic smirk
quiz.explain: The standard "微笑" is often read as passive aggression.

quiz.q: What does "666" mean?
quiz.explain: 666 — praise for skill and mastery.

quiz.q: A friend writes "88." What do they mean?
quiz.explain: 88 (bā bā) sounds like 拜拜 — "bye."

quiz.q: What's the best way to show that something is funny to you?
quiz.explain: 哈哈哈 — sincere laughter; 呵呵 and a lone 哦 can sound cold.

role.ai_role: Xiao Wang, a 22-year-old Chinese pen pal on WeChat, who writes briefly, with lots of slang and numbers
role.user_goal: support a friend before an exam, praise their success with slang, arrange to meet up, and say a warm goodbye in WeChat style
role.opening: 啊啊啊明天考驾照，我好紧张，我太难了😭
checklist: cheer them on (加油！)
react to their success with slang (666/太牛了/yyds)
use 哈哈哈 instead of 呵呵
confirm an arrangement (收到/好哒)
say goodbye the online way (88/拜拜)
